detail.abstract: Background: Computational therapeutic design has advanced rapidly through artificial intelligence and machine learning approaches, yet no standard representation exists for the therapeutic candidate as a structured, computable decision object. Current minimum information standards address experiments (MIAME), models (MI-CLAIM), and assays (MIQE) but not the translational candidate itself. Gap: The absence of a candidate-level representation standard fragments therapeutic design across target biology, molecular optimization, delivery engineering, safety assessment, and regulatory planning. This fragmentation impedes reproducible evaluation, cross-modality comparison, and governed advancement decisions. Contribution: This paper introduces Therapeutic Candidate Decision Records (TCDRs) as computable translational objects and TCDR-MI as a minimum information reporting standard for therapeutic candidate representation. The TCDR schema comprises nine field groups spanning candidate identity, biological mechanism, disease and tissue context, modality details, delivery and biodistribution, manufacturability, safety, evidence gaps, and advancement logic. A multicriteria decision analysis (MCDA) rubric enables structured advancement scoring with explicit sensitivity analysis. Methods: The TCDR schema was derived through a structured four-stage process: (1) systematic enumeration of fields from 14 source standards, frameworks, and regulatory guidance documents; (2) gap analysis identifying translational attributes absent from all surveyed sources; (3) iterative consolidation into nine field groups; and (4) minimum information classification following the MIAME three-tier precedent. A competitive landscape analysis across 25 references confirmed the absence of any comparable standard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了治疗候选药物决策记录（TCDRs）作为可计算的转化对象，并制定了TCDR-MI最低信息报告标准，用于标准化治疗候选药物的结构化表示，以解决当前缺乏候选级别表示标准的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何为治疗候选药物建立一个标准的、可计算的结构化决策对象表示，以弥合从靶点生物学到监管规划的转化设计碎片化？
AI.motivation: 现有最低信息标准（如MIAME、MI-CLAIM、MIQE）覆盖实验、模型和 assays，但缺乏针对治疗候选药物本身的结构化、可计算表示标准，导致跨靶点生物学、分子优化、递送工程、安全性评估和监管规划的设计碎片化，阻碍了可重复评估、跨模态比较和受控的推进决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 转化医学中的候选药物决策记录理论、最低信息标准理论（借鉴MIAME三层次分类法）、多准则决策分析（MCDA）理论。
AI.method: 四阶段结构化流程：（1）从14个源标准、框架和监管指南中系统枚举字段；（2）差距分析识别所有被调查来源中缺失的转化属性；（3）迭代整合为九个字段组；（4）遵循MIAME三层次先例进行最低信息分类。同时通过25篇参考文献的竞争格局分析确认无类似标准存在。
AI.findings: 开发了TCDR模式，包含九个字段组：候选身份、生物学机制、疾病与组织背景、模态细节、递送与生物分布、可制造性、安全性、证据差距和推进逻辑。设计了基于MCDA的结构化推进评分方法及显式敏感性分析。竞争格局分析表明该标准具有独创性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了治疗候选药物作为可计算转化对象的新理论概念；建立了候选级最低信息标准框架，填补了实验、模型、检测与候选药物之间的标准化鸿沟；将MCDA引入候选药物推进决策的结构化评估。
AI.practical_contributions: 为治疗候选药物的跨模态比较、可重复评估和受控推进决策提供了标准化工具；支持从靶点生物学到监管规划的全链条整合；有助于提高转化医学研发效率和决策透明度。

title: The Lazy Miner Hypothesis: Efficiency-Driven Cantillon Effects in Bitcoin
affiliations: University of Vaasa

detail.title: The Lazy Miner Hypothesis: Efficiency-Driven Cantillon Effects in Bitcoin

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have no significant competing financial, professional, or personal interests that might have influenced the performance or presentation of the work described in this manuscript.

detail.abstract: Richard Cantillon (1680s-1734), an Irish-French economist and early pioneer of political economy, observed that those closest to new money creation gain purchasing power before prices adjust throughout the economy. Bitcoin miners occupy precisely this position as the exclusive first receivers of every newly minted bitcoin. Yet unlike banks in fiat systems, miners cannot retain this advantage indefinitely because the protocol subjects them to relentless competition. This paper proposes the Lazy Miner Hypothesis: when mining profitability deteriorates following halving-induced supply shocks, inefficient operators exit first, generating a predictable sequence of revenue compression, hash rate decline, and subsequent price recovery that redistributes first-receiver gains from weak miners to patient investors. Using daily data from September 2014 to January 2026, a miner stress indicator combining depressed revenue with declining computational commitment predicts 90-day forward returns of 36.5 percentage points after controlling for Federal Reserve policy and energy costs. The coefficient is virtually unchanged when WTI crude oil volatility is added, confirming a protocol-native effect. Horse race regressions show miner stress dominates technical oversold indicators. Placebo tests with randomized halving schedules produce no comparable effects, and forward Sharpe ratios confirm genuine alpha. The premium declines by 12.5 percentage points per halving epoch, consistent with market learning. The approval of U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs in January 2024 significantly diminishes the effect, yet the miner stress signal remains positive and statistically significant, indicating that institutional absorption is underway but incomplete. Bitcoin's competitive mining structure thus transforms Cantillon dynamics from permanent insider advantages into temporary, efficiency-driven rewards that erode as markets mature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"懒惰矿工假说"：比特币减半后，低效矿工退出导致算力下降和价格回升，将首批接收者优势从弱势矿工重新分配给耐心投资者。矿工压力指标可预测90天远期回报36.5个百分点，且机构进场后效应减弱但未消失。
AI.research_question: 比特币矿工作为新币的独家首批接收者，能否在减半冲击后维持坎蒂隆效应（购买力优势）？矿工的竞争退出机制如何影响比特币的价格动态？
AI.motivation: 传统坎蒂隆效应认为靠近货币创造源头的群体永久享有购买力优势。比特币的竞争性挖矿结构是否改变了这一经典经济效应？减半事件是否通过矿工退出机制产生可预测的价格回报？
AI.theoretical_framework: 坎蒂隆效应（Cantillon Effect）、竞争性挖矿结构、矿工压力指标、市场学习假说、减半供给冲击理论
AI.method: 使用2014年9月至2026年1月的日度数据，构建矿工压力指标（低迷收入+算力下降），进行预测回归、马赛回归（与超卖指标对比）、安慰剂检验（随机减半时间）、夏普比率分析及分阶段子样本检验。
AI.findings: 1) 矿工压力指标预测90天远期回报36.5个百分点，不受美联储政策或能源成本影响；2) 该效应优于技术超卖指标；3) 随机减半安排下无类似效应（确认协议原生性）；4) 每个减半纪元溢价下降12.5个百分点（市场学习）；5) 比特币ETF批准后效应减弱但仍显著（机构吸收在进行中）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将坎蒂隆效应从永久性内部人优势修正为竞争性结构下的临时效率奖励；提出"懒惰矿工假说"作为比特币价格发现的新机制；证明去中心化协议可通过竞争消除货币创造优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币投资者提供基于链上矿工行为的可交易信号；为监管者理解比特币减半事件的市场影响提供框架；揭示机构投资者（如ETF）如何逐步吸收市场非效率。

title: Sexual Violence as a Weapon of War: From the Classification of War Crime to Crime Against Humanity and Genocide

detail.title: Sexual Violence as a Weapon of War: From the Classification of War Crime to Crime Against Humanity and Genocide

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: "Ethics approval was not required for this study, as it is a purely theoretical and doctrinal legal analysis based on public jurisprudence, international treaties, and academic literature, and does not involve any human participants, patients, or field surveys.

detail.abstract: This study examines the normative trajectory of sexual violence in international criminal law, analyzing its transition from mere "attacks on honor" to major legal classifications such as war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide. The objective is to demonstrate how the evolution of international jurisprudence, particularly that of the ad hoc tribunals (ICTY and ICTR), has transformed the legal perception of these acts, making them central elements of systemic macro-criminality. The analysis is based on four theoretical pillars: evolutionary positivism, macro-criminality, the constructivist approach to identity destruction, and the doctrine of due diligence. The results highlight that the classification as "torture" (war crime) now ensures the non-applicability of statutory limitations (imprescriptibility) to these acts, while the classification as a "crime against humanity" reveals their strategic function in the forced displacement of populations. Furthermore, the study highlights the genocidal dimension of rape when used as a weapon of biological and symbolic destruction aimed at the annihilation of a protected group. Finally, the research establishes a direct correlation between state failure and the persistence of impunity. It concludes that the threat of extreme international legal classification remains the most effective lever to compel national authorities to fulfill their responsibility to protect. This reflection calls for increased synergy between academic and judicial institutions to restore effective sovereignty of protection.

AI.tldr: 本文考察了国际刑法中性暴力从"侵犯名誉"到战争罪、危害人类罪和种族灭绝罪等主要法律分类的规范化演变轨迹，论证了国际判例法（特别是前南刑庭和卢旺达刑庭）如何转变了对这些行为的法律认知，使其成为系统性宏观犯罪的核心要素。
AI.research_question: 国际刑法中性暴力的法律分类如何从"侵犯名誉"演变为主流法律类别（战争罪、危害人类罪、种族灭绝罪），以及这种演变对打击有罪不罚现象产生了何种影响？
AI.motivation: 性暴力在国际刑事司法中长期被边缘化，其法律定性存在严重不足。通过揭示其规范性轨迹，可以更好地理解法律如何回应系统性暴力，并为消除有罪不罚现象提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进化实证主义、宏观犯罪理论、身份摧毁的建构主义路径、以及尽职调查原则。
AI.method: 基于国际判例法（特别是ICTY和ICTR）的法律分析，结合国际刑法理论进行规范性研究。
AI.findings: (1) 将性暴力归类为"酷刑"（战争罪）确保了这些行为不适用诉讼时效；(2) 归类为"危害人类罪"揭示了其在强制迁移人口中的战略功能；(3) 当强奸被用作生物性和象征性毁灭武器时，具有种族灭绝维度；(4) 国家失败与有罪不罚的持续存在之间存在直接关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 为性暴力的国际刑法分类演变提供了系统性的理论解释，揭示了不同法律定性背后的实质法律后果差异，建立了国家失败与有罪不罚之间的理论关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出极端国际法律分类的威胁是促使国家当局履行保护责任的最有效杠杆，呼吁学术与司法机构加强协同，恢复有效的保护主权。

title: The Green Paradox: Institutional Plant-Based Policies and the Systemic Waste of Vegetables, Fruits, and Salads in Danish Public Canteens

detail.title: The Green Paradox: Institutional Plant-Based Policies and the Systemic Waste of Vegetables, Fruits, and Salads in Danish Public Canteens
detail.abstract: Plant-based options in canteens and food procurement have become increasingly popular in public institutions in Denmark and the rest of the Nordic region due to the growing momentum of climate targets, and growing societal pressure to eat less meat. This paper questions a structurally important but understudied consequence of this shift, known as the green paradox, whereby the production of vegetables, fruits, salads and starchy staples vastly exceeds diner demand, resulting in systematic plant-based food waste. We evidence that avoidable food waste occurs predominantly from plant-derived foods by mass approximately 30% of all avoidable household food waste is attributed to vegetables and salads alone in Danish households, while school-meal experiments suggest up to 59% in the form of starchy staples in Nordic institutional settings. Meanwhile, the amount of meat wasted is smaller, yet its share of the carbon footprint of waste is disproportionately larger. The paradox arises at the intersection of three dynamics: institutional green signalling through abundant plant-based buffets; a mismatch between menu supply and actual diner preferences; and weak real-time waste tracking by food category. We argue that the supply-side substitution logicreplacing meat with more vegetablescannot succeed without demand-sensitive procurement, portion calibration, and waste measurement transparency. We propose a conceptual smart canteen platform, GreenBalance, integrating real-time waste scales, machine-learning demand forecasting, nudge-based pre-ordering and intrainstitutional surplus redistribution, and outline a four-study empirical research agenda grounded in the Danish context.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了北欧公共餐饮体系向植物性食品转型过程中的"绿色悖论"：植物性食材因供应远超需求而大量浪费，尽管肉类浪费量较少，但其碳足迹占比却不成比例地高。作者提出一个集成实时称重、机器学习需求预测、助推预订单和剩余再分配的智能食堂平台"GreenBalance"并规划了四阶段实证研究议程。
AI.research_question: 向植物性食品转型过程中，北欧公共餐饮体系（食堂、学校餐食）是否存在系统性的植物性食物浪费（"绿色悖论"）？其成因与解决方案是什么？
AI.motivation: 植物性食品选项在公共机构中日益普及，但"绿色悖论"——植物性食材因供应过剩而大量浪费——这一结构性但未被充分研究的后果亟需关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色悖论（Green Paradox）；供给侧替代逻辑；需求-供给匹配理论；助推理论（Nudge Theory）
AI.method: 混合方法：丹麦家庭食物浪费数据定量分析（约30%蔬菜沙拉浪费）、北欧机构学校餐食实验数据（高达59%淀粉类主食浪费），并规划四项实证研究议程（包括实时称重、机器学习预测、助推预订单和机构间剩余再分配）。
AI.findings: 1. 植物性食物浪费量远大于肉类（丹麦家庭中蔬菜沙拉占可避免浪费的约30%；北欧机构中高达59%）；2. 肉类浪费量虽小，但其碳足迹占比却不成比例地大；3. 悖论源于三重动力：绿色信号导致自助餐过量供应、菜单与食客偏好错配、缺乏分类实时浪费追踪。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并系统阐释了公共餐饮领域的"绿色悖论"概念，挑战了"用植物替代肉类自然减少环境足迹"的简单假设，揭示了供给侧替代逻辑的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 设计GreenBalance智能食堂平台（实时称重+机器学习需求预测+助推预订单+机构内剩余再分配），为公共机构减少植物性食物浪费提供了可操作的技术与管理方案。

title: Entrepreneurship Training and Entrepreneurs' Perceptions of Ability: A Randomized Control Trial in Tanzania
affiliations: VU University Amsterdam, Bocconi University and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill

detail.title: Entrepreneurship Training and Entrepreneurs' Perceptions of Ability: A Randomized Control Trial in Tanzania

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki and approved by the Institutional Review Board of the University of Maryland, College Park (project number 1634929; original approval: February 26, 2021).
declarations.funderStatement: Support for this research was generously provided by: The Rockefeller Foundation (Grant 2018 FOD 004); the Foundation for Food and Agriculture Research (Grant DFs-18-0000000008); and the Ed Snider Center for Enterprise and Markets at the University of Maryland.

detail.abstract: This study examines whether training entrepreneurs to apply systematic approaches to strategic decision-making influences their self-perception of ability. Using a field experiment in which 151 entrepreneurs in Tanzania were randomly assigned to two different versions of entrepreneurial training (an evidence-based vs. a theory-and-evidence-based approach), we find entrepreneurs in the theory-and-evidence-based condition experience a larger and more persistent increase of their self-perception of ability to deal with challenges compared to the evidence-based condition. Additionally, entrepreneurs across the two conditions respond differently to the training depending on their initial levels of perceived ability. By integrating insights from social cognitive psychology, this study contributes to research on entrepreneurial experimentation by uncovering the effect of strategic decision-making training on individuals themselves, not just their ventures' outcomes. Managerial summary Entrepreneurs' self-perceptions of ability are critical for how they engage with learning opportunities and respond to challenges that arise as they develop their businesses. To explore how different versions of training on strategic decision-making impact entrepreneurs' self-perceived abilities to deal with such challenges, we conducted a field experiment with Tanzanian agribusiness entrepreneurs. Results show entrepreneurs who learn to develop a theory-of-value before engaging in experimentation experience a larger increase in self-perceived ability compared to those who experiment without such a theory-of-value, and this effect persists for longer. Our results have practical value for entrepreneurs and support organizations offering training programs and point to self-perception of ability as an important factor to help entrepreneurs follow the behavioral advice they receive during those trainings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过坦桑尼亚151位企业家的田野实验，发现相比纯证据导向的训练，同时包含理论与证据的创业训练更能持久提升企业家应对挑战的自我能力认知，且这种效果因企业家初始自我认知水平而异。
AI.research_question: 训练企业家应用系统化方法进行战略决策是否会改变他们的自我能力认知？
AI.motivation: 企业家的自我能力认知对其如何利用学习机会和应对创业挑战至关重要，但不同版本的创业训练如何影响这一认知尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会认知心理学；创业实验理论；自我效能感理论
AI.method: 田野实验：将坦桑尼亚151位企业家随机分配至两种创业训练条件（纯证据导向 vs. 理论与证据结合导向），追踪比较其自我能力认知的变化。
AI.findings: （1）理论与证据结合组的自我能力认知提升更大且更持久；（2）不同初始能力认知水平的企业家对两种训练的反应存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了战略决策训练对创业者"自身"（而非仅对创业结果）的影响，将创业实验研究的关注点从企业绩效扩展到创业者的心理认知层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者和培训机构提供指导：在实验前先构建"价值理论"能更有效提升创业者的自我能力认知；指出自我能力认知是帮助创业者真正践行培训行为建议的关键因素。

title: Telehealth’s Double-Edged Sword: Hidden Costs of Expanding Access to Virtual Care
affiliations: Miami Herbert Business School, University of Miami, University of Miami - Department of Management Science, University of Miami and University of Miami

detail.title: Telehealth’s Double-Edged Sword: Hidden Costs of Expanding Access to Virtual Care
detail.abstract: Telehealth visits are widely recognized for their capacity to improve patient access to care. However, less is known about how already overworked physicians are adapting to this increased demand, particularly against the backdrop of an ongoing physician shortage. Our study investigates the impact of telehealth adoption on physician workload and the resulting implications for physician burnout and healthcare revenues. We analyze approximately 4 million activity records from 467 physicians across three departments (General Medicine, Neurology, and Dermatology) of a major U.S. healthcare system between 2019 and 2023. Leveraging granular variation in telehealth adoption, we use a difference-indifferences approach to compare high-and low-adopting physicians. We find that telehealth adoption resulted in a substantial expansion of physicians' patient panel; yet, surprisingly, this growth occurred without an increase in visit volume. Our analysis uncovers the likely mechanisms underlying this shift: physicians reallocated visit slots from follow-ups and procedures to new patient consultations and increasingly managed follow-ups through asynchronous messaging. These findings suggest that while telehealth expanded patient access, it also substantially increased physicians' workload and reshaped their clinical workflows. Our subsequent analyses indicate that this additional workload may have contributed to physician burnout and attrition. Moreover, the shifts in clinical workflows contributed to substantial revenue losses for the healthcare organization. Telehealth's potential to expand patient access may come at the cost of increased workload and shifts in physician workflows. These changes can contribute to physician burnout and attrition as well as revenue losses for healthcare organizations. Healthcare organizations should develop strategies to manage the increased workload and also reconsider physician compensation models to better align individual incentives with organizational goals. Meanwhile, policymakers should revise reimbursement models to adequately compensate telehealth services, including asynchronous messaging. Without such reforms, the long-term sustainability of telehealth may be at risk.

AI.tldr: 远程医疗扩大了患者的就诊可及性，但显著增加了医生的工作量，改变了临床工作流程，导致医生倦怠、人员流失以及医疗机构收入损失。
AI.research_question: 远程医疗的采用如何影响医生的工作量、工作倦怠以及医疗机构的收入？
AI.motivation: 远程医疗被认为能改善患者就诊可及性，但医生短缺背景下，医生如何适应远程医疗带来的需求增加尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作量扩展理论、医生行为经济学、工作流程再分配理论
AI.method: 基于2019-2023年美国某大型医疗系统467名医生约400万条活动记录，采用双重差分法比较高低采用远程医疗的医生。
AI.findings: 远程医疗扩大了患者接诊量，但未增加访问量；医生将随访和程序时段重新分配给新患者咨询，并通过异步消息管理随访；这增加了医生工作量，导致倦怠和流失，同时造成医疗机构收入损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了远程医疗采用与医生工作量之间"量变但非质变"的悖论关系，提出了工作流程再分配作为解释机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议医疗机构重新设计医生薪酬模型，政策制定者修订远程医疗（包括异步消息）的报销模型，以保障远程医疗的长期可持续性。

title: Untangle Air Connectivity and Tourism Development in China's Domestic Market
affiliations: and University of British Columbia (UBC) - Sauder School of Business

detail.title: Untangle Air Connectivity and Tourism Development in China's Domestic Market
detail.abstract: This paper examines how domestic air connectivity shapes spatial patterns of tourism development in China. We construct a Domestic Airport Connectivity Index (DACI) at the city level for 2000-2024 and employ an instrumental variable strategy to address potential endogeneity, using the interaction between high-speed rail (HSR) expansion and proximity to hub airports as an instrument. The results show that stronger air connectivity significantly boosts tourism development. A one-unit rise in DACI is associated with a 36.5% increase in arrivals and a 61% increase in revenue, which corresponds to 9.5 million additional tourists and 17 billion CNY in additional revenue per city-year. These findings highlight the disproportionate contribution of air travel to higher-value tourism demand. More broadly, the results indicate that aviation plays a unique and complementary role alongside HSR in facilitating domestic mobility and supporting tourism flows across regions. This study contributes by introducing a network-based measure of domestic air connectivity, providing causal evidence of its impact on tourism, and offering new insights from China's dual aviation-HSR transport environment. The results underscore the importance of aviation policy as a lever for promoting tourism development and balanced regional growth.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了2000-2024年中国城市级国内航空连通性指数（DACI），利用高铁扩张与枢纽机场距离的交互作用作为工具变量，发现航空连通性显著提升旅游发展：DACI每上升一个单位，游客到达量增加36.5%，旅游收入增加61%。研究强调航空与高铁在促进国内旅游中的互补作用。
AI.research_question: 国内航空连通性如何影响中国旅游发展的空间格局？
AI.motivation: 航空连通性对旅游发展的因果效应尚缺乏严谨的实证证据，且现有研究未充分考虑航空与高铁这两种重要交通方式在中国独特交通环境下的互补关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交通基础设施与旅游发展的关系理论；航空连通性对旅游需求的拉动效应理论；高铁与航空在区域交通中的互补性理论。
AI.method: 构建城市级国内航空连通性指数（DACI）；采用工具变量法处理内生性问题，以高铁扩张与枢纽机场距离的交互作用作为工具变量；面板数据涵盖2000-2024年。
AI.findings: 航空连通性显著促进旅游发展：DACI每上升一个单位，游客到达量增加36.5%，旅游收入增加61%，相当于每个城市-年份增加950万游客和170亿元旅游收入；航空对高价值旅游需求的贡献尤为突出；航空与高铁在促进国内旅游中发挥独特且互补的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入基于网络的国内航空连通性测量方法；提供航空连通性对旅游发展因果效应的严谨证据；在"航空-高铁"双交通体系背景下提供新的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了航空政策作为促进旅游发展和区域均衡增长杠杆的实证依据；揭示了航空与高铁协同发展的政策价值。

title: Ethical and Human-Rights Constraints on AI-Assisted Decision-Making: The Dignity-and-Autonomy Test as an Interpretive Layer across CRPD, ICCPR, and the Victorian Charter
affiliations: Independent Researcher, Melbourne, Australia

detail.title: Ethical and Human-Rights Constraints on AI-Assisted Decision-Making: The Dignity-and-Autonomy Test as an Interpretive Layer across CRPD, ICCPR, and the Victorian Charter
detail.abstract:
Public authorities in health, social security, child protection, and custodial settings increasingly rely on

algorithmic inputs — risk-assessment scores, triage classifiers, benefit calculators — when taking decisions that deprive persons of liberty, impose compulsory treatment, or withdraw essential services. Existing human-rights instruments already supply substantive constraints on such decisions; what has been missing is an operational specification of how those constraints apply when the decision-making chain is mediated by an algorithm that is, by design, opaque to the person it affects.

This paper argues that AI ethics discourse functions as an interpretive layer upon — not a parallel framework beside — the dignity, autonomy, liberty, equality, and procedural-fairness guarantees already embedded in the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD), the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR), and the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act 2006 (Vic). The operative vehicle is the Dignity-and-Autonomy Test: a three-limb standard requiring, in any rights-engaging algorithmically assisted decision, 

(1) that the affected person can comprehend, in an accessible form, what the system is doing and how

it bears on them; (2) that before any irreversible step the person has a genuine, time-adequate opportunity to consent, refuse, or invoke human review; and (3) that a clearly named human authority remains identifiable and reachable for recourse.

These three limbs operationalise, respectively, obligations in CRPD Articles 12, 14, and 25; ICCPR Article 9; and Charter ss 21, 24, 25(2)(b), and 38. A non-discrimination corollary completes the framework: where an algorithm produces disparate impact on protected groups, the State bears a reverse evidentiary burden to demonstrate necessity, proportionality, and demonstrated ex-ante and ex-post bias auditing under CRPD Articles 5 and 12,

Charter s 8, EO Act s 8, and DDA s 6. The paper maps each failure mode to its optimal forum, applies the test through an anonymised composite compulsory-treatment scenario under the MHWA 2022 (Vic), and surveys remedies from declaratory relief to systemic algorithmic moratoriums. The contribution is to close the AI- governance gap not by waiting for dedicated legislation, but by specifying how courts, tribunals, and regulators must read existing rights guarantees when a public authority relies on an algorithmic input.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"尊严与自主性测试"三步骤标准，用于评估公共机构在算法辅助决策中是否履行了既有国际人权法（CRPD、ICCPR等）规定的义务，从而弥合AI治理与人权保障之间的操作性鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 当公共决策链中嵌入不透明的算法时，既有国际人权文书中的尊严、自主、自由、平等和程序公正保障条款应如何被具体操作化适用？
AI.motivation: 健康、社会保障、儿童保护和羁押领域的公共机构越来越多地依赖算法输入（如风险评估、分类器、福利计算器）来做出剥夺自由、强制治疗或撤销基本服务的决策，但现有权利保障缺乏针对算法中介决策的操作性规范。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI伦理话语作为人权法的解释层（而非平行框架）；尊严与自主性测试（三步骤标准：可理解性、真正的同意/拒绝/人工审查机会、可识别的责任人）；非歧视推论（反向举证责任）。
AI.method: 法律教义学分析，将三步骤标准映射至CRPD、ICCPR、维多利亚州宪章等具体条款，并通过MHWA 2022（维多利亚州）强制治疗场景的匿名复合案例进行应用检验。
AI.findings: 三步骤标准分别操作化了CRPD第12、14、25条，ICCPR第9条及维多利亚州宪章相关条款；非歧视推论要求国家在算法对受保护群体产生差别影响时承担反向举证责任，证明必要性、比例性及前后偏差审计。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI伦理话语重新定位为人权解释层而非替代框架，通过既有权利条款的操作化弥合AI治理缺口，无需等待专门立法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院、裁判所和监管机构提供了可直接适用的操作标准（尊严与自主性测试），并绘制了不同失败模式对应的最优救济论坛及从宣告性救济到系统性算法暂停的救济路径。

reference: Journal of Competition Law & Economics
title: Beyond Interchange Fee Caps: Rethinking Merchant Choice and Competition in European Payments
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt, Imperial College Business School and Goethe University Frankfurt - House of Finance

detail.title: Beyond Interchange Fee Caps: Rethinking Merchant Choice and Competition in European Payments
detail.abstract: This article examines the persistent challenges in European payment markets a decade after the EU Interchange Fee Regulation. Despite fee caps on debit and credit card transactions, merchants continue to face limited choice and high, often opaque costs, as international card schemes raise non-regulated fees and consumer reliance on cash diminishes. We argue that regulation focused solely on price caps has proven insufficient to address structural imbalances at the point of sale and, possibly to a lesser extent, in e-commerce. While we also set out proposals for adjusting fee regulation, the core of our analysis is a shift in policy towards strengthening merchants' effective choice of payment instruments. Two complementary approaches are developed: first, enabling merchants to initiate direct debit transactions directly from payment card data, thus creating a genuine outside option that disciplines card-based fees; second, breaking single-homing of cardholders by requiring banks to issue multiple branded debit cards or by preventing (quasi-)exclusive issuing arrangements. We also explore tentative remedies in e-commerce and mobile payments, where merchants may, on the one hand, enjoy a wider choice, but digital wallets and intermediaries may also create new "must-have" bottlenecks. Overall, the paper advocates structural reforms to restore competition rather than relying exclusively on fee regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文指出欧盟交换费法规实施十年后，仅靠价格上限不足以解决支付市场结构性失衡问题，主张通过增强商户有效选择权（如从银行卡数据发起直接借记、打破持卡人单一归属）来恢复竞争，而非依赖单纯的费率监管。
AI.research_question: 为何欧盟交换费法规未能有效解决支付市场结构性失衡，以及如何通过结构性改革恢复竞争？
AI.motivation: 欧盟交换费法规实施十年后，商户仍面临有限选择和高昂隐性成本，国际卡组织提高非监管费用，现金使用减少导致问题加剧，表明单纯价格上限手段失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 支付市场竞争理论、双边市场理论、单一归属与多归属理论、结构性改革与价格管制比较。
AI.method: 规范性政策分析，提出两种结构性改革方案并探讨其可行性。
AI.findings: 1）单纯费率上限不足以解决支付市场结构性失衡；2）允许商户从支付卡数据发起直接借记可创造有效外部选择；3）打破持卡人单一归属（如强制发行多品牌借记卡）可增强竞争；4）数字钱包和中介在移动支付中可能形成新的瓶颈。
AI.theory_contributions: 将双边市场理论应用于支付监管分析，提出超越传统价格管制的结构性竞争修复框架，丰富了支付市场竞争政策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及各国监管机构提供支付市场改革的具体政策建议：商户发起直接借记、打破单一归属安排等结构性措施，以及对电商和移动支付领域的初步监管方向。

reference: Vanderbilt Law Research Paper(forthcoming)
title: Race, Rurality, and Marginalisation in the American South
affiliations: Vanderbilt University - Law School

detail.title: Race, Rurality, and Marginalisation in the American South

publicationDetails.journalName: Vanderbilt University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This book chapter--included in Global Reflections on Positionality in Rural Access to Justice Research (edited by Michele Statz & Daniel Newman)--explores the intersection of race, rurality, and marginalization in the context of access to justice research, drawing on personal experiences as a multiracial woman, lawyer, and academic working in the American South. It argues that shared experiences of marginalization can forge unexpected connections between researchers and the communities they study, creating a distinctive foundation for research — while also cautioning that such shared identity has necessary limits and should not obscure important differences. The chapter situates these reflections within the structural realities of rural Southern communities, which face compounding disadvantages: concentrated poverty,  a dearth of legal resources and support, and systematic exclusion from national policymaking and dominant access to justice narratives. The chapter explores how rurality, race, and geography layer to produce acute barriers to legal services, and reflects critically on how researchers' positionality — including class, race, and institutional affiliation — shapes both their access to these communities and the knowledge they produce. For more information on the book, visit: https://www.bloomsbury.com/uk/academic/law/.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在获取司法公正的研究中，种族、乡村性和边缘化之间的交叉关系。作者以自身作为美国南部的多种族女性、律师和学者的经历，论证了共同的边缘化经历可以在研究者与其所研究的社区之间建立意想不到的联系，形成独特的研究基础，同时也警示这种共享身份有其必要限度，不应掩盖重要差异。
AI.research_question: 在乡村司法公正研究中，研究者的种族、乡村性和边缘化身份如何影响其与研究对象社区之间的关系，以及这些身份如何塑造知识生产？
AI.motivation: 美国南部乡村社区面临严重司法资源匮乏和政策边缘化，而研究者自身的身份定位如何影响研究过程与伦理这一问题常被忽视。作者希望通过自身经历揭示共享边缘化体验的潜力与局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 位置性（positionality）理论、交叉性（intersectionality）理论、批判地理学、乡村司法公正研究
AI.method: 反思性自述（reflexive narrative）、自传体方法（autoethnographic approach）
AI.findings: 共享边缘化经历可促成研究者与社区之间的独特连接，但这种共享身份不应抹平差异；乡村性、种族和地理因素相互叠加，产生严重的司法服务障碍；研究者的阶级、种族和制度隶属影响其进入社区的能力和所产出的知识。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了位置性理论在乡村司法公正研究中的应用，将种族与乡村性交叉分析引入司法公正研究领域，揭示了共享边缘化体验的研究伦理张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从事乡村司法公正研究的研究者提供了反思自身身份定位的实践框架；提示研究者在利用共享身份建立信任的同时，需警惕身份简化论；为美国南部乡村司法政策制定提供边缘群体的视角参考。

title: Mobile AGI Physical-Layer Security Framework: Topological Geometric Offload and Thermodynamic Hardware Interlocks

detail.title: Mobile AGI Physical-Layer Security Framework: Topological Geometric Offload and Thermodynamic Hardware Interlocks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and sole owner of PhysLayer IP Holdings LLC and the inventor/holder of related intellectual-property filings concerning physical-layer security, topological geometric offload, thermodynamic hardware interlocks, and hardware roots of trust. The author may derive future commercial benefit from licensing, partnership, assignment, or commercialization of related inventions. No external employment, consulting, advisory, equity, or sponsored relationship with any AI, semiconductor, telecommunications, cloud-infrastructure, or cybersecurity vendor influenced the preparation of this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This work is a theoretical and engineering preprint concerning mobile AGI physical-layer security, hardware roots of trust, and thermodynamic interlock architectures. No human subjects, animal subjects, personal data, or biological samples were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All conceptual development, technical documentation, modeling, simulation, hardware-security analysis, and manuscript preparation were self-funded by the author as an independent researcher through personal resources and PhysLayer IP Holdings LLC.

detail.abstract:
As consumer smartphones evolve from single-shot inference devices into 24/7 Mobile AGI terminals, sensors, ISP, NPU, memory, package interconnects, and power management are no longer merely performance components; they become the physical basis for human oversight, privacy protection, and safe interruption. This paper proposes a mobile-device physical-layer security framework constrained by power, cybersecurity, and regulation, as a consumer-device companion to the 6G fronthaul TGO white paper (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20328129).

The architecture contains three core layers. L1, Topological Geometric Offload (TGO), uses high-dimensional geometric priors and an Mproj: ℝN → ℝ3 mapping to reduce Leq variation in phone-package and sensor-interconnect paths. L2, orthogonal out-of-band transient perturbation ζ(t), provides a local tuning path for package thermal dynamics and dielectric continuity. L3, the Zeno-Triggered Joule Latch (ZTJ-L), is treated as an irreversible or semi-permanent hardware root of trust that can provide a forensic end-state Fend under specified unauthorized sensing, thermodynamic abnormality, or latency-race imbalance conditions.

ZTJ-L (Zeno-Triggered Joule Latch), ECM (Environmental Entropy Coupling), SII (Spatial Inertial Phase Identification), CVD (Causal Vacuum Detection), and Fend (Forensic End-State) are introduced as audit-framework terminology and are first defined here in the academic record.

Unlike the V7.5 telecom-infrastructure paper focused on AAU, 256TRx, bypass TRL/AFR, S-parameters, and DSP relief, this paper targets the consumer smartphone: Mobile AGI always-on power stack, sensor-to-agent security chain, physical-causality anti-fraud, and compliance mapping to the EU AI Act, GDPR, and repairability.

Three physical-causality anti-fraud mechanisms are proposed. ECM provides evidence for deepfake events lacking natural environmental entropy. SII supports detection of fake base stations, phishing channels, and physical-source inconsistencies. CVD checks whether logical data events are decoupled from thermal, electrical, or I/O events. These mechanisms do not replace cryptography or software security; they fill a physical-evidence gap left by software logs, blacklists, and content classifiers under AGI-generated fraud.

The CVD layer is, to the author's knowledge, the first application of Landauer's principle of irreversible computation as a foundation for anti-fraud evidence chains, repositioning fraud detection from logical-layer pattern matching to physical-dissipation matching.

The paper presents an auditable conceptual architecture rather than a deployment commitment or performance claim. Its hypotheses can be verified or rejected using battery drain, skin temperature, NPU duty cycle, memory bandwidth, uplink duty cycle, thermal throttling time, Leq variation, S-parameters, EVM, sensor cut-off time, OS/API tracing, side-channel baselines, ECM/SII/CVD evidence packets, and Fend end-state inspection.

Release Positioning and Non-Weaponization Statement: This document is an academic preprint. It does not constitute a commercial offer, licensing proposal, compliance certification, legal opinion, or enabling disclosure. The ZTJ-L hardware interlock is positioned strictly as a consumer-device security and forensic-evidence mechanism. It is not designed, tested, or proposed for military, weapons, law-enforcement active-defense, or dual-use applications. The author makes no claim regarding its applicability under EAR, ITAR, EU Dual-Use Regulation (2021/821), or any other export-control regime. Any future implementation must independently complete export-control compliance assessment in the relevant jurisdiction. Device-level non-public implementation parameters and business-sensitive information are intentionally omitted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向消费级智能手机的物理层安全框架，包含TGO、正交瞬态扰动ζ(t)和Zeno触发焦耳锁存器(ZTJ-L)三层架构，定义了ECM、SII、CVD等审计术语，将Landauer不可逆计算原理首次应用于反欺诈证据链，填补AGI生成欺诈场景下物理证据的空白。
AI.research_question: 如何构建面向24/7全天候移动AGI终端的消费级智能手机物理层安全架构，以应对传感器、ISP、NPU、内存、封装互连和电源管理等硬件层面的安全挑战？
AI.motivation: 智能手机正从单次推理设备演变为全天候移动AGI终端，现有安全机制多聚焦于软件层和逻辑层，缺乏对物理层安全、隐私保护和可审计性的系统性框架，尤其缺乏对AGI生成欺诈的物理证据链支撑。
AI.theoretical_framework: ①拓扑几何卸载（TGO）高维几何先验映射理论；②正交带外瞬态扰动（ζ(t)）理论；③Zeno触发焦耳锁存器（ZTJ-L）不可逆硬件信任根理论；④Landauer不可逆计算原理（应用于反欺诈证据链）；⑤环境熵耦合（ECM）、空间惯性相位识别（SII）、因果真空检测（CVD）等物理因果性反欺诈理论。
AI.method: 概念架构设计方法，提出了三层物理层安全框架（L1 TGO、L2 ζ(t)、L3 ZTJ-L），定义了新的审计术语体系，并提出了可验证的假设检验指标体系（电池耗电、皮肤温度、NPU占空比、内存带宽、上行链路占空比、热节流时间、Leq变异、S参数、EVM、传感器截止时间、OS/API追踪、侧信道基线等十余项可测量指标）。
AI.findings: ①提出了完整的三层消费级手机物理层安全架构；②首次将Landauer不可逆计算原理引入反欺诈领域，将欺诈检测从逻辑层模式匹配转向物理耗散匹配；③提出了三种物理因果性反欺诈机制：ECM（环境熵缺失检测深度伪造）、SII（虚假基站和钓鱼信道检测）、CVD（逻辑事件与热/电/I/O事件的因果一致性检验）；④定义了Fend（法医终态）作为不可逆硬件信任根的审计终态；⑤构建了与EU AI Act、GDPR和可维修性法规的合规映射。
AI.theory_contributions: ①将Landauer不可逆计算原理从理论物理学扩展到反欺诈证据链的应用领域，开辟了物理耗散匹配作为新型取证范式的理论路径；②提出了物理因果性反欺诈的理论框架，区别于传统的软件日志、黑名单和内容分类器范式；③建立了消费级设备物理层安全与电信级6G前传TGO白皮书之间的理论连接。
AI.practical_contributions: ①为消费级智能手机在AGI时代提供了面向物理层的安全审计框架；②提供了可直接验证/否证的量化指标体系（十余项可测量参数），便于实验复现；③为设备厂商和监管机构提供了合规映射路径（EU AI Act、GDPR、可维修性法规）；④通过ZTJ-L硬件互锁机制，提供了不可逆的硬件信任根和法医取证能力。

title: Mergers, Innovation Efficiencies, and the Investment Channel
affiliations: , Luiss Guido Carli University and European Union - Directorate General for Competition

detail.title: Mergers, Innovation Efficiencies, and the Investment Channel
detail.abstract: We study how mergers affect innovation and buyer surplus when suppliers invest before competing for a contract awarded to the best supplier. The merger's effect on innovation decomposes into a Schumpeterian effect (larger profit base) and an Arrowian effect (lost rivalry). Without synergies, these cancel exactly: the merger is innovation neutral and harms the buyer by the merger premium. Private and social investment incentives are aligned, so merger-specific synergies always increase total welfare. However, the buyer benefits only indirectly, through competitive pressure the stronger merged entity exerts on outsiders, and only if the innovation gain exceeds the merger premium. In the presence of external spillovers the merger can be more detrimental to welfare. A joint venture that coordinates investment while preserving competition avoids the premium and, in our numerical analysis, benefits the buyer more than the merger across all specifications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当供应商在合同竞标前进行创新投资时，并购如何影响创新和买方剩余。研究发现：无协同效应时并购创新中性但损害买方；兼并对买方有利的条件是创新收益超过并购溢价；合资企业比并购更有利于买方。
AI.research_question: 当供应商在竞标前进行创新投资时，并购如何影响创新水平、买方剩余和社会福利？
AI.motivation: 传统产业组织理论中，并购的"熊彼特效应"（扩大利润基础激励创新）与"阿罗效应"（竞争减少降低创新动力）相互抵消，但缺乏对买方剩余和竞标环境的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 熊彼特效应、阿罗效应、并购溢价、外部溢出效应
AI.method: 理论模型分析，辅以数值模拟
AI.findings: (1)无协同效应时，熊彼特效应与阿罗效应完全抵消，并购创新中性但损害买方；(2)买方仅当创新增益超过并购溢价时才能间接受益；(3)外部溢出使并购更损害福利；(4)合资企业优于并购。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了并购对创新的双重效应在竞标环境下的净效应，区分了并购对买方和整体福利的不同影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断政策提供指导：无协同效应的并购应被审慎对待；合资企业可能是比并购更优的组织形式。

Background & Purpose: As biodiversity loss increasingly becomes a cross-environmental threat to global economic stability and security, this study uses the framework of the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the recently agreed Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity, 2022) to develop a framework of data from conservation and predictive risk engineering, here called the Algorithmic Security Matrix (ASM).

title: Audit Committee Characteristics and Integrated Reporting: Evidence from Selected Listed Non-Financial Firms in Nigeria
affiliations: Institute of Management and Technology (IMT), Enugu

detail.title: Audit Committee Characteristics and Integrated Reporting: Evidence from Selected Listed Non-Financial Firms in Nigeria

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced the study
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved the collection of primary data through structured questionnaires, interviews, conducted with participants who were fully informed about the purpose of the research. Participation was voluntary, and informed consent was obtained from all respondents prior to their involvement. Confidentiality and anonymity of all participants were strictly maintained throughout the study.

detail.abstract: This study examined the effects of audit committee characteristics on integrated reporting of a selected group of listed non-financial companies in Nigeria. The study specifically looked at how integrated reporting quality was affected by audit committee size, meetings, independence, and financial expertise. The study used a descriptive survey research approach, and 230 respondents-top management personnel, accountants, and internal auditors of selected companies were given standardized questionnaires to complete in order to gather data. Using SPSS version 25, multiple regression analysis and descriptive statistics were used to evaluate the data at the 5% significance level. The study's empirical findings were strengthened and given more contextual support by including the SWOT and PESTEL assessments. The audit committee size has a little but significant influence on integrated reporting, as per the regression results (R = 0.145, R² = 0.021, p = 0.028). Audit committee meetings (p = 0.308), audit committee independence (p = 0.550), and audit committee financial expertise (p = 0.129) had no significant effect on integrated reporting. Additionally, the combined impact of all audit committee attributes did not exhibit statistical significance (R 2 = 0.039, p = 0.059). The study comes to the conclusion that integrated reporting quality cannot be much improved by audit committee features alone. It is recommended that businesses increase the efficacy of their audit committees by providing ongoing training, enhancing their independence, integrating them with corporate reporting frameworks, environmental, social, and governance (ESG), and emphasizing performance-based governance over structural compliance.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了尼日利亚非金融上市公司审计委员会特征对整合报告质量的影响。研究发现，除审计委员会规模对整合报告有微弱但显著的影响外，会议频率、独立性和财务专长均无显著影响；审计委员会特征单独无法显著提升整合报告质量，建议企业应注重绩效导向治理与持续培训。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚非金融上市公司审计委员会特征（规模、会议频率、独立性、财务专长）如何影响整合报告质量？
AI.motivation: 整合报告作为新兴的企业报告框架，其质量受多种治理因素影响。审计委员会在公司治理中扮演关键角色，但现有文献对审计委员会特征与整合报告之间关系的研究不足，特别是在尼日利亚等新兴市场背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论（审计委员会作为监督机制）、资源依赖理论（审计委员会提供专业知识与资源）
AI.method: 描述性调查研究；向230名高层管理人员、会计师和内部审计师发放标准化问卷；采用SPSS 25进行多元回归分析和描述性统计；同时纳入SWOT和PESTEL分析以增强实证结果的语境支持。
AI.findings: 审计委员会规模对整合报告有微弱但显著的正向影响（R=0.145, R²=0.021, p=0.028）；审计委员会会议频率（p=0.308）、独立性（p=0.550）和财务专长（p=0.129）对整合报告无显著影响；所有审计委员会特征的综合效应不显著（R²=0.039, p=0.059）。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统代理理论中审计委员会特征与报告质量直接相关的假设，揭示了在整合报告这一新兴领域，治理结构特征的作用可能有限，需要结合制度环境与组织能力进行解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议企业不应仅依赖审计委员会的结构性特征（如会议频率、独立性、财务专长）来提升整合报告质量，而应注重持续培训、增强实际独立性、将审计委员会与ESG及企业报告框架整合，并强调绩效导向治理而非结构合规。

title: Dynamic Consistency in Cumulative Stage-weighting Rules
affiliations: Merope

detail.title: Dynamic Consistency in Cumulative Stage-weighting Rules
detail.abstract: Many multi-stage competitions aggregate per-stage scores using cumulative weights that change at each stage boundary. We formulate a dynamic-consistency requirement for cumulative stage weighting and characterise the class of weighting schemes that satisfy it. A scheme is dynamically consistent if and only if it is order-equivalent to a fixed-stage-weight cumulative sum. This identifies the design class of cumulative weighting schemes that aggregate completed stages without rewriting their relative standing. Any violation admits score profiles at which the ordering on already-observed data is reversed at the stage transition, before any new performance is recorded. The scheme used in the 19th International Chopin Piano Competition (2025) violates the property at both non-trivial transitions; using the official rounded raw stage averages, the Stage 3 → Final re-weighting would swap the contestants ranked 10th and 12th at the top-eleven boundary. The pathology lies in the weighting layer and is independent of any score-correction rule.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多阶段竞赛中累计加权方案的动态一致性，给出了满足该性质的充要条件，并以2025年肖邦钢琴大赛为例展示了加权方案违反该性质导致排名异常的现象。
AI.research_question: 多阶段竞赛的累计加权方案应满足什么样的动态一致性要求？哪些加权方案满足该要求？
AI.motivation: 多阶段竞赛中，阶段间的权重变化可能导致已观察数据的排名在无新表现记录的情况下发生逆转，这种病理现象需要理论刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态一致性（dynamic consistency）、序等价性（order-equivalence）、固定阶段加权累计和（fixed-stage-weight cumulative sum）。
AI.method: 理论推导：定义动态一致性公理，刻画满足该公理的加权方案特征。案例分析：以2025年第19届国际肖邦钢琴大赛为例，展示权重变化导致的排名逆转现象。
AI.findings: （1）加权方案动态一致当且仅当它序等价于某个固定阶段权重的累计和。（2）违反该性质时，存在已观察数据的排名在阶段交界处发生逆转。（3）2025年肖邦钢琴大赛的加权方案在Stage 3→Final的非平凡过渡中，使得原本排名第10和第12的选手发生互换。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并公理化多阶段竞赛累计加权方案的动态一致性条件，刻画了满足该条件的方案类。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多阶段竞赛（如音乐比赛、体育联赛、学术评审等）的评分规则设计提供了规范性准则，帮助避免因权重设计不当导致的排名反转问题。

detail.abstract:
Transportation electrification is expected to become a major source of long-run electricity-demand growth in the United States at a time when the electric grid is already facing mounting pressure from AI-driven data-center expansion, domestic manufacturing reshoring, and broader economy-wide electrification trends. These converging demand pressures carry important implications for electric-grid infrastructure, utility planning, transmission investment, and automotive-sector investment. Yet most existing electric-vehicle (EV) forecasts operate primarily at the national level, offering limited guidance for state-level and regional infrastructure planning despite substantial cross-state heterogeneity in EV adoption patterns and electricity-demand impacts.

This paper develops a national- and state-level framework for forecasting light-duty battery electric vehicle (BEV) adoption and associated electricity demand across all 50 US states and the District of Columbia from 2026 to 2040. The framework combines a national Bayesian logistic diffusion model with state-specific adoption ceilings estimated through an ensemble regression incorporating charging-infrastructure density, urbanization, gasoline prices, household income, and ZEV-mandate status, linked to a bottom-up vehicle-category electricity-demand model. Three scenarios (conservative, base, accelerated) bracket the range of plausible long-run adoption outcomes.

Under the base scenario, the stock-weighted US average BEV new-car sales share rises from 8.04% in 2025 to 26.1% by 2030 and 49.4% by 2040. The analysis identifies a persistent divergence between ZEV-mandate and non-mandate states, with the adoption gap widening from +5.4 percentage points in 2025 to +31.5 percentage points by 2040 (63.5% versus 32.0%). State-level projections span 87.0% (California and Washington) to 10.1% (West Virginia). Light-duty BEV adoption alone is projected to increase annual U.S. electricity demand by approximately 61 TWh in 2030 and 326 TWh in 2040. Relative to 2025 U.S. retail electricity sales (4,058 TWh), the 2040 increase is equivalent to roughly 8.04% additional demand. Across scenarios, the estimated incremental demand in 2040 ranges from 246 to 397 TWh. State-level BEV-driven electricity-demand growth ranges from +26.19% (California) to +0.93% (West Virginia), representing an approximately 28x spread across jurisdictions. The framework also projects cumulative new light-duty BEV sales of approximately 83.23 million units in the United States between 2026 and 2040 under the base scenario.

These findings suggest that nationally aggregated EV-adoption assumptions may obscure materially different infrastructure requirements across states and regional utility systems. The framework developed in this paper provides a transparent and reproducible approach for analyzing the geographic distribution of transportation electrification and its implications for transmission planning, distribution-system reinforcement, charging-infrastructure deployment, and long-horizon utility and automotive-sector investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个覆盖美国50个州及哥伦比亚特区的轻型纯电动汽车（BEV）采用率与电力需求预测框架。研究发现，到2040年，零排放汽车（ZEV）强制令州与非强制令州之间的采用率差距将扩大至31.5个百分点，各州BEV驱动的电力需求增长幅度差异可达28倍。全国聚合的电动汽车预测可能会掩盖各州间显著不同的基础设施需求。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够同时进行全国和州级层面的轻型纯电动汽车（BEV）采用率及电力需求预测的框架？各州在BEV采用率和电力需求影响方面存在何种程度的异质性？
AI.motivation: 现有电动汽车预测大多聚焦于全国层面，无法为州级和区域级基础设施规划提供有效指导，而各州在电动汽车采用模式和电力需求影响方面存在显著异质性。同时，交通电气化正面临来自AI数据中心、制造业回流等电力需求的叠加压力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯逻辑斯蒂扩散模型（Bayesian logistic diffusion model）、集成回归（ensemble regression）、自底向上车辆类别电力需求模型。
AI.method: 将全国贝叶斯逻辑斯蒂扩散模型与基于充电基础设施密度、城市化率、汽油价格、家庭收入和ZEV强制令状态估计的州级采用上限相结合，并与自底向上的车辆类别电力需求模型对接。设定保守、基准、加速三种情景。
AI.findings: 基准情景下，BEV新车销售占比将从2025年的8.04%升至2040年的49.4%；ZEV强制令州与非强制令州的采用率差距从+5.4个百分点扩大至+31.5个百分点；2040年BEV驱动年电力需求增加约326 TWh（占2025年零售电量的8.04%）；各州电力需求增长差异达28倍（加州+26.19% vs 西弗吉尼亚+0.93%）；2026-2040年累计新增BEV销量约8323万辆。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将全国扩散模型与州级异质性因素（如ZEV强制令、充电基础设施）结合的预测框架，揭示了全国聚合预测在区域规划中的局限性，并量化了跨州电力需求差异的巨大程度（28倍）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为州级和区域级输电规划、配电系统强化、充电基础设施部署以及公用事业和汽车行业的长期投资决策提供了一个透明、可复现的分析工具。

title: When Code Meets Custody: How the Proposed CLARITY Act and Ondo Finance Are Reshaping Securities Tokenization
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: When Code Meets Custody: How the Proposed CLARITY Act and Ondo Finance Are Reshaping Securities Tokenization
detail.abstract: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act) represents a pivotal legislative effort to resolve the jurisdictional ambiguity between the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) over digital asset regulation. This paper examines the relationship between the CLARITY Act and the emerging market for tokenized real-world assets, using Ondo Finance as a primary case study. Through analysis of regulatory frameworks, market data, and legal structures, the paper argues that the Act's primary impact lies not in legalizing tokenization per se, but in providing a pathway for U.S. retail investor participation. Current market capitalization of tokenized equities reached $1.43 billion as of May 2026, representing 26% monthly growth, while Ondo Finance maintains approximately 60% market share. The paper analyzes Ondo's wrapped tokenization model, its pending no-action letter request with the SEC, and the legal risks associated with bankruptcy remoteness and custodial arrangements. The analysis concludes that while tokenization offers legitimate efficiency gains, its growth depends critically on regulatory outcomes and the resolution of untested legal questions regarding tokenholder claims in insolvency proceedings.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了《数字资产市场清晰法案》（CLARITY Act）如何通过明确SEC与CFTC的监管边界，为美国散户投资者参与代币化现实世界资产（RWA）市场提供可行路径，并以Ondo Finance为案例揭示了监管不确定性和破产隔离等法律风险对市场发展的制约。
AI.research_question: CLARITY Act如何影响代币化现实世界资产市场的发展？其核心机制是直接合法化代币化行为，还是为美国散户投资者参与提供监管路径？
AI.motivation: SEC与CFTC对数字资产监管的管辖权模糊长期阻碍市场发展，代币化现实世界资产（RWA）快速增长（截至2026年5月代币化股票市值达14.3亿美元），但缺乏明确的法律框架支撑其可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管管辖权理论、代币化资产法律结构分析（包括破产隔离、托管安排、无异议函机制）
AI.method: 案例研究法（以Ondo Finance为核心案例）、监管框架分析、市场数据分析、法律结构分析
AI.findings: CLARITY Act的主要影响不在于合法化代币化本身，而在于为美国散户投资者参与提供了监管路径；Ondo Finance占据约60%市场份额；代币化资产面临破产隔离和托管安排等未经检验的法律风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了监管清晰度与散户投资者参与之间的直接关联机制；界定了代币化合法化与投资者准入路径之间的理论区别。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了CLARITY Act实际影响的实证评估；为市场参与者揭示了代币化RWA的关键法律风险（破产追索权问题）；为Ondo Finance等企业提供了监管合规策略参考。

title: Group Creativity with AI: The Outcome-Experience Paradox

detail.title: Group Creativity with AI: The Outcome-Experience Paradox
detail.abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) is increasingly used in creative group work; however, its influence on collaborative creative processes remains poorly understood. This paper identifies the outcome-experience paradox: a consistent pattern across recent empirical studies in which groups using AI produce creative outputs rated slightly better than groups not using AI, while participants report diminished creativity, reduced engagement, and weaker collaborative dynamics. The paper proposes that the paradox arises because current AI implementations optimize for idea generation while inadvertently dismantling the interpersonal mechanisms through which group creativity generates both its experiential value and its most significant outcomes. Three possible explanations are proposed: agency displacement, interaction suppression, and premature convergence. Building on this analysis, the paper argues for a reorientation of AI's role in group creativity toward process support: AI that addresses established obstacles to group creative performance while preserving human creative agency, with content generation deployed strategically rather than as the default mode. The paper concludes by suggesting that designing AI systems that support groups' creative processes, not just outcomes, is a worthwhile challenge for the field of computational creativity.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI在创意团队中产生了"结果-体验悖论"：输出质量略好，但成员创造力、参与度和协作体验下降。原因在于AI优化了想法生成，却破坏了人际协作机制。建议将AI角色从内容生成转向过程支持。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何影响创意团队的协作过程？为何会出现"输出质量提升但体验下降"的矛盾现象？
AI.motivation: 尽管GenAI越来越多地被用于创意团队协作，但其对协作创意过程的影响仍不清晰，且已有实证研究呈现出结果与体验相悖的稳定模式，亟需理论解释和设计方向指引。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结果-体验悖论（outcome-experience paradox）；群体创造力的人际机制理论；代理权转移、交互抑制、过早收敛三种解释机制。
AI.method: 文献综合与理论分析：基于近期多项实证研究的系统性观察，识别一致性模式，提出理论解释框架。
AI.findings: ①存在"结果-体验悖论"：AI组输出质量略高，但用户体验（创造力感知、参与度、协作动态）显著更差；②悖论源于AI优化想法生成却破坏了群体创意的人际机制；③提出三种解释：代理权转移、交互抑制、过早收敛；④建议AI应转向过程支持，保留人类创意代理权，策略性地使用内容生成。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别并命名"结果-体验悖论"；从人际机制视角解释了AI为何削弱群体创意体验；提出了AI角色从内容生成到过程支持的理论转向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计创意协作AI系统提供明确方向：不应只追求输出质量，而应支持团队的创意过程；为开发者和管理者提供了避免AI破坏团队协作的具体机制参考（代理权、交互、收敛速度）。

title: Market-Based Liquidity Transformation
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Finance

detail.title: Market-Based Liquidity Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: We develop a theory of liquidity transformation in which the secondary-market price of a tradable wrapper (corporate bond ETFs, CLO ETFs, and stablecoins) plays a dual role: it clears the wrapper market against dealer-authorised-participant (AP) arbitrage, and serves as the public signal on which long-term holders condition their hold-or-sell decision and the AP conditions its balance-sheet commitment. Uniqueness of equilibrium depends on wrapper-side absorption capacity as well as on private-signal precision. Adverse shocks generate a mild regime with a sustained wrapper discount or a severe regime in which the sponsor's AUM rule triggers basket liquidation at fire-sale prices. The tradable wrapper produces two pecuniary externalities, addressable by a Pigouvian redemption tax and an AP balance-sheet subsidy. Fragility runs through dealer balance sheets, so regulation should target balance-sheet capacity rather than reserve adequacy.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个理论模型，研究可交易包装工具（如公司债券ETF、CLO ETF和稳定币）的流动性转换机制，分析其双重价格功能、均衡唯一性条件、冲击下的不同运行状态，并提出通过Pigouvian赎回税和AP资产负债表补贴来矫正两种货币外部性，最终指出监管应关注做市商资产负债表容量而非准备金充足性。
AI.research_question: 可交易包装工具（tradable wrapper）的二级市场价格如何同时发挥市场出清和公共信号的双重作用？在不利冲击下，这种机制如何导致温和折价或严重清盘两种状态？
AI.motivation: 理解公司债券ETF、CLO ETF和稳定币等可交易包装工具在流动性转换中的独特作用机制，揭示其在二级市场交易中的脆弱性，并为监管提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性转换理论，涉及做市商-授权参与者（AP）套利、长期持有者基于公共信号的持有-出售决策、AP的资产负债表承诺决策，以及均衡唯一性取决于包装侧吸收能力和私人信号精度。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与分析，通过均衡条件推导不同冲击状态下的市场行为，并分析外部性与监管干预。
AI.findings: 1) 可交易包装的二级市场价格具有双重作用：出清市场并提供公共信号。2) 均衡唯一性取决于包装侧的吸收能力和私人信号精度。3) 不利冲击会导致两种结果：温和的持续折价状态或严重的火线清盘状态。4) 可交易包装产生两种货币外部性，可通过赎回税和AP补贴纠正。5) 脆弱性源于做市商资产负债表，监管应关注资产负债表容量而非准备金充足性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统构建了可交易包装工具的流动性转换理论，揭示了二级市场价格的双重功能及其导致的均衡复杂性，区分了两种冲击状态，并提出了针对性的外部性纠正机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ETF、稳定币等金融产品的监管提供了理论指导：监管重点应从准备金充足性转向做市商资产负债表容量，并建议采用Pigouvian赎回税和AP资产负债表补贴等政策工具。

title: Learning from LGBT+ Policy Research: Transfer Dynamics and the Politics of Visibility in the Diffusion of Mandatory Disclosure Rules for Tax Arrangements

detail.title: Learning from LGBT+ Policy Research: Transfer Dynamics and the Politics of Visibility in the Diffusion of Mandatory Disclosure Rules for Tax Arrangements
detail.abstract: Why do governments hesitate to take action against cross-border tax avoidance by multinational enterprises and wealthy individuals? This study addresses this question by examining the transfer of Mandatory Disclosure Rules for Tax Arrangements (MDR) from international tax fora to Germany over a period of more than a decade. To explain the observed transfer dynamics, the study draws on insights from morality policy research, particularly studies on the diffusion of LGBT+ policies. Drawing on Ayoub's Politics of Visibility framework, the study shows that policymaking on MDR in Germany was strongly shaped by shifting levels of issue visibility. While low levels of visibility initially hindered policy adoption, rising visibility following the global financial crisis politicised the issue and altered the conditions under which policy transfer became politically feasible. The study theorises these dynamics through a causal mechanism termed the hegemonic discourse mechanism. A causal process-tracing analysis demonstrates how this mechanism unfolded in the empirical case. By linking theories of tax policy diffusion with theories of morality policy diffusion, the study contributes to research on transfer dynamics in global tax governance, demonstrates how politicisation reshapes transfer trajectories, and advances the theorisation of the politics of tax policy diffusion beyond predominantly rationalist accounts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了德国为何在十多年后才将国际税务论坛的强制披露规则（MDR）转化为国内政策。通过引入Ayoub的"可见性政治"框架，发现议题可见性的变化（全球金融危机后上升）是推动政策转移可行性的关键因素，并提出了"霸权话语机制"来解释这一动态过程。
AI.research_question: 为什么政府在应对跨国避税问题上犹豫不决？具体而言，德国为何花了十多年时间才将国际税务论坛的强制披露规则（MDR）转化为国内政策？
AI.motivation: 跨国企业和富裕个人的跨境避税问题长期存在，但许多国家在其国内政策制定中迟迟不采取行动。现有研究对此现象的解释力不足，需要从政策扩散和政治可见性的角度加以探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了道德政策研究（特别是LGBT+政策扩散研究）中的Ayoub"可见性政治"框架，提出了"霸权话语机制"（hegemonic discourse mechanism）作为因果机制。
AI.method: 因果过程追踪（causal process-tracing），对德国MDR政策转移案例进行深入分析。
AI.findings: 低水平的议题可见性最初阻碍了政策采纳；全球金融危机后议题可见性上升，使该问题政治化，改变了政策转移的政治可行性条件。"霸权话语机制"解释了这一动态过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 将税收政策扩散理论与道德政策扩散理论联系起来，丰富了全球税务治理中的转移动态研究；展示了政治化如何重塑政策转移轨迹；推进了税收政策扩散政治的理论化，超越了主流理性主义解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了议题可见性和政治化在推动国际税务规则国内转化中的关键作用，为政策制定者和国际组织理解并克服政策采纳障碍提供了理论依据。

title: Nonlinear Segregation Dynamics in Schooling Markets: the Case of Caste in India
affiliations: University of California, Santa Cruz, , affiliation not provided to SSRN and Harvard University - Graduate School of Arts and Sciences

detail.title: Nonlinear Segregation Dynamics in Schooling Markets: the Case of Caste in India
detail.abstract: We study whether local schooling markets in India exhibit tipping-point dynamics in student caste composition. Using near-universal administrative panel data on schools, we define villages as local schooling markets and estimate village-level composition thresholds from the relationship between baseline caste shares and subsequent enrollment flows, adapting the Card et al. (2008) fixed-point procedure to multi-school markets. We study two caste contrasts: upper-caste versus all disadvantaged groups combined, and intermediate-caste versus the most marginalized. Estimated thresholds differ sharply across contrasts and concentrate at very different baseline shares, indicating that tipping is boundary-specific rather than a generic feature of composition change. Around these thresholds, within-village school segregation rises discontinuously by 12% for the upper-caste comparison and 42% for the within-disadvantaged caste comparison. These are driven by resorting across schools within the local market rather than shifts in village composition. School inputs and public grant flows exhibit parallel discrete changes at the same thresholds, with per-student grants jumping by about 30%. Threshold locations are lower where caste identity is more salient and higher where schooling markets are thicker, though both gradients largely reflect state-level heterogeneity. Together, these findings show that institutional responses to composition amplify household sorting, generating a supply-side response that affects school quality.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度近乎全覆盖的学校行政面板数据，研究地方教育市场中学生种姓构成的 tipping-point 动态。发现 tipping 阈值在不同种姓对比组间差异显著，且阈值附近学校隔离、投入和公共拨款呈现不连续变化，表明机构应对放大家庭分选，产生影响学校质量的供给侧响应。
AI.research_question: 印度地方教育市场中，学生种姓构成是否存在 tipping-point 动态？不同种姓对比组的 tipping 阈值有何差异？
AI.motivation: 已有文献主要关注美国种族居住 segregation 的 tipping 现象，但对印度种姓制度下教育市场的 tipping 动态缺乏研究，且对多学校市场的 tipping 机制理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: Tipping-point 理论（Schelling 模型）、学校分选理论、供给侧响应理论
AI.method: 采用 Card et al. (2008) 固定点程序，将其扩展到多学校市场；利用近乎全覆盖的印度学校行政面板数据，以村庄为地方教育市场单位，估计种姓构成阈值。
AI.findings: (1) 不同种姓对比组的 tipping 阈值差异显著，上等种姓 vs 弱势群体的阈值与中间种姓 vs 最边缘化群体的阈值位于不同的基线份额水平；(2) 阈值附近村庄内学校隔离不连续上升12%-42%；(3) 学校投入和公共拨款在阈值处出现不连续变化，生均拨款跃升约30%；(4) 阈值位置在种姓身份更凸显的地区更低，在教育市场更厚的地区更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 将 tipping-point 理论从种族居住 segregation 扩展到印度种姓制度下的教育市场，揭示了多学校市场中 tipping 的边界特异性，并引入供给侧响应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度教育政策制定提供实证依据，表明种姓构成 tipping 会触发学校隔离加剧和资源配置的不连续变化，提示政策应关注阈值附近的干预窗口。

title: Racing Queues with Strategic Servers
affiliations: University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management and

detail.title: Racing Queues with Strategic Servers
detail.abstract: We study racing queues, a type of multi-server queueing system in which strategic servers race against each other to complete jobs. Once any server completes the active job, that server earns a prize and all servers move to the next job in the shared queue. Each server chooses her service rate to maximize utility; serving faster wins more often but is more costly. Using exact analysis, we identify the unique symmetric equilibrium service rate in closed form across three regimes-overloaded, critically loaded, or underloaded-determined by the prize amount relative to marginal capacity cost. Notably, the equilibrium service rate can be non-monotonic in the number of servers. Under appropriate conditions, it first increases then decreases, revealing an "ideal" level of competition that maximizes individual server effort. Otherwise, reduced effort may completely eliminate any capacity gain from an additional server. We also fully characterize the equilibrium's intricate relationship with the degree of elasticity in the capacity cost function. Finally, we endogenize the prize amount. When job value is high, the optimal prize sustains a critically loaded equilibrium; otherwise, it induces an overloaded equilibrium. The profit-maximizing prize is systematically below the surplus-maximizing level, with relative surplus loss uniformly bounded above.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种名为"竞速队列"的多服务器排队系统，其中战略性服务器竞相完成任务以获得奖励。通过精确分析，确定了唯一的对称均衡服务速率，并发现该速率随服务器数量呈非单调变化（先增后减），揭示了存在一个"理想"竞争水平。研究还发现，当工作价值高时，最优奖励维持临界负载均衡；否则导致过载均衡。利润最大化奖励始终低于剩余最大化水平。
AI.research_question: 在竞速队列系统中，战略性服务器如何选择服务速率以达到均衡？奖励金额与服务器数量如何影响均衡服务速率？如何确定利润最大化的奖励金额？
AI.motivation: 在现实世界中（如拼车平台、任务众包等），多个服务提供者竞争完成任务的现象十分普遍，但传统排队论通常假设服务器被动工作，忽略了它们的战略行为。本研究旨在填补这一空白，理解竞争如何影响服务器努力程度和系统效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞速队列模型、博弈论（对称纳什均衡）、排队论（过载/临界/欠载三种状态）、容量成本函数弹性分析、内生奖励机制设计
AI.method: 精确解析分析：建立竞速队列的博弈论模型，推导对称均衡服务速率的闭式解；分析三种负载状态下的均衡特性；研究服务速率与服务器数量的非单调关系；内生奖励金额的优化分析。
AI.findings: (1) 存在唯一的对称均衡服务速率闭式解，分为过载、临界负载和欠载三种状态；(2) 均衡服务速率随服务器数量呈非单调变化（先增后减），存在"理想"竞争水平；(3) 在某些条件下，额外增加服务器可能完全消除容量增益；(4) 工作价值高时最优奖励维持临界负载均衡，否则导致过载均衡；(5) 利润最大化奖励低于剩余最大化水平，且相对剩余损失有统一上界。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从博弈论角度系统分析竞速队列中服务器战略行为与竞争结构的关系，揭示了服务速率与服务器数量之间的非单调关系，提出了"理想竞争水平"概念，并将排队系统分析与内生激励设计相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台运营者（如拼车平台、任务分配系统）提供了设计奖励机制的理论指导；揭示了增加服务提供者并不总是提高效率的"竞争悖论"；给出了利润最大化与剩余最大化奖励之间的差距及其上界，有助于平台在效率和利润之间权衡。

title: Navigating Asia's Path to a High-Income and Sustainable Future
affiliations: Bruegel, Institute of Policy Studies of Sri Lanka, Cornell University - Department of Economics, The University of Manchester, Australian National University (ANU) - Crawford School of Public Policy, Yonsei University, Australian National University (ANU) - School of Economics, Australian National University (ANU), University of Tokyo, and Research Institute of Economy, Trade and Industry (RIETI), Korea University, Asian Development Bank Institute, Australian National University, Aoyama Gakuin University, Global Solutions Initiative Foundation GmbH, London School of Economics and Political Science, Asian Development Bank Institute, Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), Free University of Berlin (FUB),Environmental Policy Research Center, Global Solutions Initiative Foundation GmbH, University of Delhi - Department of Economics, Asian Development Bank Institute, Asian Development Bank Institute, Sunway University College, University of Lausanne, University of London - School of Oriental and African Studies (SOAS) - Economics, Padjadjaran University and National School of Development, Peking University

detail.title: Navigating Asia's Path to a High-Income and Sustainable Future
detail.abstract:
The ascent of Asia’s economies is a seminal narrative of modern global development, yet this historic trajectory has reached a critical juncture. The region now stands at the precipice of a new era, defined not by the certainty of convergence but by the complex challenge of securing sustainable, high-income status. While the post-war model—propelled by capital accumulation, export-led growth, and demographic dividends—delivered unprecedented poverty reduction, its momentum is faltering. Widespread productivity slowdowns, rapidly aging populations, and binding environmental constraints present formidable internal headwinds. These are compounded by a shifting global landscape characterized by technological disruption, geopolitical fragmentation, and a reconfiguration of international supply chains. This confluence of internal and external pressures underscores a stark reality: the strategies of the past are necessary but insufficient for the future. Navigating this transition demands a fundamental rethinking of growth paradigms, making the pursuit of innovative and resilient development pathways an urgent imperative for policymakers across the continent.

This volume, Navigating Asia’s Path to a High-Income and Sustainable Future, is the product of the Asian Development Bank Institute’s 2024 Annual Conference, which convened leading scholars and practitioners to dissect these very challenges. The book moves beyond a narrow focus on income metrics to provide a holistic examination of the prerequisites for advanced development. Its analysis spans the critical dimensions of this transition—from institutional foundations and technological disruption to demographic shifts, geopolitical risks, and the imperatives of green growth. The contributors provide compelling evidence that urgent action is required to advance this holistic approach, which integrates economic resilience with social inclusivity and environmental sustainability.

By assembling this diverse and rigorous body of research, the volume arrives at a central thesis: achieving durable high-income status is an intrinsically multidimensional endeavor. The book argues convincingly that economic policies must be consciously designed to foster social inclusion, build institutional resilience, manage technological change, and safeguard natural capital simultaneously. This integrated perspective is particularly critical for Asia and the Pacific, where the scale of the transformation must be matched by the ambition and coherence of its policy response. For policymakers, academics, and development practitioners, this book serves as an indispensable guide. It provides not only a diagnostic of the intricate challenges at hand but also a forward-looking agenda for crafting the integrated strategies essential for a prosperous, inclusive, and sustainable Asian century.

AI.tldr: 本书基于亚行研究所2024年会成果，提出亚洲经济体要实现可持续的高收入地位，必须采取超越传统增长模式的多维综合策略，同时推动经济韧性、社会包容与环境可持续性。
AI.research_question: 亚洲经济体如何在面临生产率放缓、人口老龄化、环境约束及全球地缘政治分裂等内外挑战的背景下，实现可持续的高收入地位？
AI.motivation: 亚洲经济崛起虽取得巨大成就，但战后以资本积累、出口导向和人口红利为动力的传统增长模式正面临动力衰退，亟需重新审视增长范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多维发展理论（超越单一收入指标）、制度经济学、技术变革管理、人口转型理论、绿色增长理论
AI.method: 会议论文合集，汇集多位学者和从业者的研究，涵盖制度基础、技术颠覆、人口结构变化、地缘政治风险、绿色增长等多个维度。
AI.findings: 实现持久的高收入地位本质上是一个多维度的综合工程；经济政策必须同时促进社会包容、增强制度韧性、管理技术变革和保护自然资本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并论证了高收入地位的多维本质，将经济韧性、社会包容与环境可持续性整合为统一分析框架，超越了传统以收入指标衡量发展的单维视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为亚太地区政策制定者提供转型期政策路标，强调综合策略的紧迫性；为学者和发展从业者提供诊断工具和前瞻性议程。

title: Coherence as an Extension of the Organizational Design Canon
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University - Heinz College

detail.title: Coherence as an Extension of the Organizational Design Canon
detail.abstract: This research note positions the Living Enterprise framework (Singh, 2026) within the organizational design canon. The framework is offered not as a replacement of Mintzberg, Galbraith, or Laloux, but as an extension of these traditions to a specific design problem: what organizational architecture is appropriate when AI agents perform most of the operational work, governance is continuous and runtime rather than periodic, and human judgment is concentrated at named coherence points rather than distributed across functional hierarchies. The note has three contributions. First, it specifies the intellectual lineage of the framework, identifying where it extends Mintzberg's configurations, Galbraith's Star Model, and Laloux's evolutionary purpose. Second, it presents the Spotify Model as a structured counter-case, showing how the documented failure modes of cargo-cult adoption inform the framework's design choices. Third, it names four empirical conditions under which the framework would predict its own failure, converting it from a closed system into a testable proposition. A research agenda for cross-industry validation is proposed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Living Enterprise框架，将其定位为组织设计经典理论的扩展而非替代，专门解决AI承担大部分运营工作、治理持续运行时、人类判断集中于特定节点的组织架构设计问题。通过梳理学术谱系、对比Spotify模型的反面案例、提出四个可证伪的失败条件，将框架从封闭系统转化为可检验的命题。
AI.research_question: 当AI代理承担大部分运营工作、治理变为持续运行时而非周期性、人类判断集中在命名的一致性节点而非分布于职能层级时，何种组织架构是合适的？
AI.motivation: 现有组织设计理论（Mintzberg, Galbraith, Laloux）未充分回应AI深度嵌入运营工作后的组织架构需求，需要一个新的框架来填补这一设计空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Living Enterprise框架，其理论谱系延伸自Mintzberg的组织构型理论、Galbraith的星形模型和Laloux的进化型目的理论。
AI.method: 理论定位与学术谱系梳理、结构化反面案例对比（Spotify Model）、提出可证伪的失败条件以实现理论的可检验性。
AI.findings: （1）明确了Living Enterprise框架在组织设计经典理论中的谱系位置；（2）通过Spotify Model的"货崇拜"采纳失败模式，验证了框架设计选择的合理性；（3）提出了四个实证条件下框架会失败的预测，使其成为可检验的开放命题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Living Enterprise框架定位为Mintzberg、Galbraith、Laloux等经典理论的延伸而非替代，并通过对失败条件的明确命名，将框架从封闭的理论系统转化为可供实证检验的学术命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI深度嵌入运营的组织提供了具体的架构设计参考；通过Spotify Model的反面案例警示了"货崇拜"式采纳的风险；提出了跨行业验证的研究议程以指导实践应用。

title: Kinetic Neutrality-The Steady State of Capital Throughput in the Agentic Economy

detail.title: Kinetic Neutrality-The Steady State of Capital Throughput in the Agentic Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declare a potential financial interest as this research may inform future commercial autonomous execution frameworks. The lead researcher holds a leadership position in a firm developing such technologies.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study consists of theoretical modeling, architectural analysis, and the synthesis of publicly available technical data. It did not involve any human participants, animal subjects, or private patient data. Consequently, formal ethics committee approval was not required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently funded and supported by the Aleph Strategy R&D Lab. No external grants, government funding, or third-party corporate sponsorships were utilized in the production of this study.

detail.abstract: This paper provides a quantitative framework for capital preservation in the agentic financial era, introducing the concept of Kinetic Neutrality as a deterministic alternative to static asset allocation. We demonstrate that the contemporary macroeconomic environment imposes a Stagnancy Theta (Θ)-a composite penalty of inflation, opportunity cost, and monetary friction-exceeding 18.5% per annum. Under these conditions, legacy "buy-and-hold" strategies function as high-entropy vessels with negative expected real returns. Utilizing high-fidelity 1-hour OHLCV exchange data and empirical performance benchmarks from Deterministic Execution Environments (DEE), this study models the transition from duration-based yield to motion-based capture. By applying a constrained Architectural Efficiency (E) filter of 0.704 and a realized turnover velocity of 18.4x, the results establish that a kinetic treasury can consistently harvest systemic volatility (𝚪) to maintain a surplus over the stagnancy hurdle. Furthermore, we define the Matrix Capacity Horizon (C H), proving that this "Superconductive State" is scale-invariant through the expansion of matrix breadth (N) across institutional-grade liquidity pools. These findings suggest that in an agentic economy, capital sovereignty is a function of deterministic motion rather than directional exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"动能中性"（Kinetic Neutrality）作为静态资产配置的确定性替代方案，证明在停滞性税（Θ）超过18.5%/年的环境下，通过受约束的架构效率（E=0.704）和高周转速度（18.4x），动能国库可系统性捕获波动性（𝚪）以超越停滞性门槛，实现资本保全。
AI.research_question: 在代理型金融时代，如何通过定量框架实现资本保全？动能中性策略能否作为静态资产配置的确定性替代方案？
AI.motivation: 当代宏观经济环境对静态"买入并持有"策略施加了超过18.5%/年的停滞性税（Θ），导致其实际期望收益为负，亟需一种基于确定性运动而非方向性敞口的资本保全新范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动能中性（Kinetic Neutrality）、停滞性税（Stagnancy Theta Θ）、架构效率（Architectural Efficiency E）、矩阵容量地平线（Matrix Capacity Horizon C_H）、超导态（Superconductive State）
AI.method: 利用高频1小时OHLCV交易所数据和确定性执行环境（DEE）的经验绩效基准，应用受约束的架构效率滤波器（E=0.704）和18.4x的实现周转速度进行建模。
AI.findings: 动能国库可通过系统性捕获波动性（𝚪）维持超过停滞性门槛的盈余；超导态（Superconductive State）通过机构级流动性池的矩阵广度（N）扩展而具有规模不变性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"动能中性"概念作为静态资产配置的确定性替代；定义停滞性税（Θ）量化静态策略的隐性成本；提出矩阵容量地平线（C_H）证明该策略的规模不变性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为代理型金融时代提供了一种基于确定性运动的资本保全定量框架；证明了在停滞性超过18.5%/年的环境下，传统"买入并持有"策略已失效，需转向运动型捕获策略。

title: All Roads Lead to the Merton Share
affiliations: and Elm Partners

detail.title: All Roads Lead to the Merton Share
detail.abstract: This note develops the Merton Share-the optimal risky-asset fraction for a constant-relative-risk-aversion investor-through six complementary routes under a single, conventional notation: a CARA-normal benchmark, a small-horizon Taylor approximation, a small-risk-premium approximation, a direct geometric-Brownian-motion calculation, dynamic programming, and the martingale method. The note is pedagogical: it is aimed at graduate students and practitioners who want to see why the same formula falls out of independent arguments, without committing to one framework. The common message is that optimal risky exposure equals compensation for risk divided by risk aversion times return variance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过六种互补方法（CARA-normal基准、小期限泰勒近似、小风险溢价近似、直接几何布朗运动计算、动态规划和鞅方法）推导出Merton最优风险资产配置比例，证明其核心公式为：最优风险敞口 = 风险补偿 / (风险厌恶 × 收益方差)。
AI.research_question: 如何通过多种互补的理论框架推导出常数相对风险厌恶（CRRA）投资者的最优风险资产比例（Merton Share）？
AI.motivation: 帮助研究生和从业者理解同一最优风险资产配置公式可以从多个独立的理论路径推导得出，而不必局限于单一框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Merton最优投资组合理论、常数相对风险厌恶（CRRA）效用函数、CARA-normal模型、泰勒近似、几何布朗运动、动态规划、鞅方法。
AI.method: 六种互补推导方法：CARA-normal基准模型、小期限泰勒近似、小风险溢价近似、直接几何布朗运动计算、动态规划方法、鞅方法。
AI.findings: 六种独立方法均推导出相同的最优风险资产配置比例公式：最优风险敞口 = 风险补偿 / (风险厌恶系数 × 收益方差)。
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了多种主流金融经济学框架下最优投资组合选择的结果，展示了Merton Share公式在不同方法论中的稳健性和一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究生和从业者提供了多角度的直观理解，帮助其灵活运用最优风险资产配置公式，而不必受限于某一特定理论框架。
