detail.abstract:
High Speed Two (HS2) is a UK government-commissioned high-speed rail programme connecting London to Birmingham and the North, procured by HS2 Ltd under Department for Transport oversight, with a 2013 baseline cost of £32.7 billion and a 2026 target opening date that has since slipped by over a decade.
In October 2013, HS2 Ltd published its Cost and Risk Status Report (Document S_A_8) — the document that would define the risk framework for the largest infrastructure project in UK history. Clause 4.4.4 of that report states: 
“The risk register for Phase One was developed through a series of interviews and reviews… These are under continual review and challenge to gain assurance that risks are being effectively managed to provide value for money.” 
One decade and £60 billion in overrun later, that sentence reads not as assurance but as caption. The total programme cost is more than £100 billion
This paper dissects the verbatim text of two foundational HS2 risk documents — the Cost and Risk Status Report (S_A_8) and the Risk Analysis Technical Documentation (S_A_2) — clause by clause, sentence by sentence. It identifies six structural deficiencies in the risk methodology that made the overrun not just possible but mathematically inevitable. It then introduces Probabilistic chain Analysis (PCA) as the corrective framework that addresses each deficiency, and applies it retroactively to the 2013 baseline to show what the true P50, P80, and P90 cost outcomes should have been.
The gap between what HS2 believed it was funding (P90) and what Flyvbjerg’s reference class distribution indicates it was actually funding (approximately P60– P66) is not statistical noise. It is the mathematical consequence of assuming independence between events that are causally connected. That gap is precisely where this paper tries to measure through PCA.

AI.tldr: 本文通过逐句剖析HS2高铁项目两份基础风险文件（S_A_8和S_A_2），识别出六项导致成本超支从“可能”变为“数学必然”的方法论缺陷，并提出概率链分析（PCA）作为纠正框架，回溯计算出2013年基准下本应得出的真实P50、P80和P90成本结果。
AI.research_question: HS2高铁项目的风险方法论存在哪些结构性缺陷，使其成本超支在数学上成为必然？概率链分析（PCA）如何纠正这些缺陷并更准确地估算大型基础设施项目的成本分布？
AI.motivation: HS2项目成本从2013年基准的327亿英镑超支至超过1000亿英镑，而原始风险文件声称“持续审查以确保风险管理有效”，这一巨大落差揭示了现有风险管理方法论的根本性失灵，亟需新的分析框架来理解和预防此类系统性超支。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概率链分析（PCA）、参考类预测（Reference Class Forecasting）、事件因果依赖性与独立性假设批判、成本风险方法论的结构性缺陷分析。
AI.method: 对HS2两份基础风险文件（S_A_8和S_A_2）进行逐条款、逐句的文本剖析，识别方法论缺陷；引入概率链分析（PCA）作为纠正框架，并回溯应用于2013年基准数据，计算出校正后的P50、P80、P90成本结果。
AI.findings: HS2风险方法论存在六项结构性缺陷，使得成本超支在数学上不可避免；项目实际风险分布（约P60-P66）远低于其声称的P90置信水平，这一差距源于错误假设事件之间的独立性；PCA能够更准确地量化因果关系驱动的成本风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了大型基础设施项目风险建模中“独立性假设”这一系统性数学谬误，提出了概率链分析（PCA）作为处理因果关联事件之间依赖性的理论框架，弥补了传统概率风险评估在方法论上的根本缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型基础设施项目的成本估算和风险管理提供了可操作的概率链分析工具；通过HS2的实证案例展示了传统风险方法的失败机制，可供政府、项目管理机构和投资者在设计风险框架时参考，避免同类系统性超支。

title: The AI-powered Recruitment Consulting Strategy
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The AI-powered Recruitment Consulting Strategy
detail.abstract: As the world recovers from the AI digital disruption crisis, the world economy is still in flux. Many jobs disappeared from the scene as many organizations adjust their workforce. Attracting the best skills and best talent has also been a challenge for many organizations. Traditional recruitment consulting strategies are outdated, and our recommendation is to move to use the AIpowered recruitment consulting strategy. The AI-powered recruitment consulting strategy revolutionizes the process of recruiting and attracting future human resources for the organization and brings extraordinary results. Results such as developing innovation and assembling a pool of top talent to better meet the ever-increasing needs of today's ever-changing business environment will be enhanced with this new recruitment consulting strategy. Much of what we share in this article comes from our management consulting experience as senior management consultants of McKinsey and Company in Sydney, Australia.

AI.tldr: 本文基于麦肯锡高级管理顾问的经验，主张在AI数字 disruption 危机后，组织应放弃传统招聘咨询策略，转向AI驱动的招聘咨询策略，以吸引顶尖人才、促进创新并适应不断变化的商业环境。
AI.research_question: 在后AI数字颠覆危机时代，组织如何通过AI驱动的招聘咨询策略有效吸引顶尖人才并适应变化的商业环境？
AI.motivation: AI数字颠覆危机导致许多工作岗位消失，组织调整劳动力结构，传统招聘咨询策略已过时，难以吸引最佳人才，亟需新的招聘策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI驱动的人才管理理论；数字化转型中的招聘创新理论。
AI.method: 基于作者在麦肯锡悉尼办公室担任高级管理顾问的实践经验与行业洞察，属于经验性/反思性文章，未采用严格的实证研究方法。
AI.findings: AI驱动的招聘咨询策略能够彻底改变组织招聘流程，带来卓越成果，包括促进创新、汇聚顶尖人才库，更好地满足当今快速变化的商业环境需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从传统招聘咨询向AI驱动招聘咨询策略转型的理论建议，丰富了数字化转型背景下人力资源管理理论的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在后危机时代提供了具体的AI招聘咨询策略方向，帮助管理者优化人才吸引与招聘流程，提升组织竞争力。

title: India's New Industrial Policy: Evaluating the Institutional Ecosystem Shaping the Production Linked Incentive Schemes
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Indore

detail.title: India's New Industrial Policy: Evaluating the Institutional Ecosystem Shaping the Production Linked Incentive Schemes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: We have obtained the ethics approval for this study from the Institutional Review Board (IRB) at the Indian Institute of Managment Indore, vide approval number: IRB/EDPM/20022025/23
declarations.funderStatement: The authors did not receive any specific funding for this research.

detail.abstract: Why does the same industrial policy (IP) yield different sectoral outcomes? This paper examines the design and governance of India's Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes for fourteen manufacturing sectors, entailing a US$24 billion payout for over 750 beneficiary firms. We triangulate data across government, media, and industry publications, supplemented by key informant interviews of government and industry stakeholders, and find an uneven uptake of the schemes. Integrating the 'Political Settlements' and 'Embeddedness-Discipline-Accountability' frameworks, we characterize PLI's features along key IP design and implementation principles. We argue that PLI's ex-post rent allocation eases governance agencies' (GA) monitoring requirements. Undertaking a case comparison of a leading (Mobile phones) and a lagging (Textiles) sector, we find the presence (or lack) of productive firms and GA's technical capabilities are associated with differential sectoral performance. Our study contributes to the literature on the importance of institutional contexts in evaluating industrial policies in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析印度生产挂钩激励计划（PLI）在14个制造业部门的实施情况，发现同一产业政策因部门异质性导致不同效果。研究整合了"政治解决"与"嵌入性-纪律-问责"框架，通过手机（领先）和纺织（落后）部门的案例比较，揭示了企业生产力水平与治理机构技术能力是影响政策效果的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 为什么相同的产业政策会在不同部门产生不同的结果？
AI.motivation: 同一产业政策在不同部门产生差异化结果的现象普遍存在，但对其背后机制的理论解释不足。印度PLI计划涉及240亿美元支出和750多家企业，为研究这一问题提供了独特的大型政策实验场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治解决框架（Political Settlements）和嵌入性-纪律-问责框架（Embeddedness-Discipline-Accountability）
AI.method: 三角验证法（政府、媒体、行业出版物数据），辅以关键知情人访谈；基于关键设计原则刻画PLI特征；领先部门（手机）与落后部门（纺织）的案例比较
AI.findings: PLI的事后租金分配方式降低了治理机构的监管要求；拥有生产力强的企业和技术能力强的治理机构的部门表现更好；反之则表现不佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家产业政策评估中制度情境的重要性提供了理论和实证证据，丰富了产业政策与制度经济学的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供产业政策设计的优化建议：需考虑部门异质性、企业生产能力基础及治理机构的技术能力，不能采取"一刀切"的政策实施方式。

title: Locked In: Closed-End Fund Governance, Shareholder Activism, and the Private Right of Rescission Under §47(b) of the Investment Company Act

detail.title: Locked In: Closed-End Fund Governance, Shareholder Activism, and the Private Right of Rescission Under §47(b) of the Investment Company Act

keywords: Oxford University Bank V. Lansuppe Feeder
FS Credit Opportunities Corp. V. Saba Capital Master Fund

detail.abstract:
Section 47(b) of the Investment Company Act of 1940 provides that contracts made in violation of the Act are unenforceable and that courts may not deny rescission "at the instance of any party," yet the statute remains silent on who retains the power to invoke that remedy, a question that has produced an entrenched circuit split with real consequences for the investment company industry.

The Second Circuit, in Oxford University Bank v. Lansuppe Feeder, LLC, held that §47(b)'s text and structure establish a semi-express private right of rescission, while the Third and Ninth Circuits have disagreed, applying Alexander v. Sandoval's restrictive implied rights framework to conclude that the absence of rights-creating language forecloses private enforcement. The Supreme Court is now poised to resolve this split in FS Credit Opportunities Corp. v. Saba Capital Master Fund, Ltd, having heard oral arguments in December 2025.

This Article argues that §47(b) does effectively imply a private right of action, not through mere judicial invention, but through the statute's own text and structure, drawing on the common law incidents of unenforceability, the parallel construction of §47(b)(1) and (2), and Congress and the SEC's express statement in accompanying reports that courts should imply private rights under the amended provision. This reading is both doctrinally consistent with prior precedent and practically necessary, particularly for closed-end fund shareholders, whose fixed capital structure and absence of redemption rights leave them with limited avenues for recourse. Contrary to industry warnings, empirical evidence suggests that rescission under §47(b) remains a targeted, contract-level remedy that supplements rather than supplants SEC enforcement of the Act.

AI.tldr: 本文主张《投资公司法》第47(b)条通过其文本、结构及立法历史隐含了私人诉权，允许合同当事人（尤其是封闭式基金股东）主张合同无效的救济，回应了各巡回法院之间的分歧。
AI.research_question: 《投资公司法》第47(b)条是否隐含了私人诉权？即除SEC执法外，私人主体是否可依据该条款主张合同无效的救济？
AI.motivation: 第47(b)条对"任何一方"可主张合同无效的救济保持沉默，导致第二巡回法院（支持私人诉权）与第三、第九巡回法院（反对）之间形成根深蒂固的分裂，对投资公司行业产生实际影响，最高法院即将在FS Credit Opportunities Corp. v. Saba Capital Master Fund, Ltd案中做出裁决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法定解释理论（文本主义、结构主义）；隐含私人诉权的法律框架（Alexander v. Sandoval案确立的"权利创设语言"标准）；普通法上合同无效的附带后果理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析（第47(b)条的措辞与结构）、比较法解释（各巡回法院判决的对比分析）、立法历史分析（国会与SEC的伴随报告）、实证分析（§47(b)撤销救济的实际使用数据）。
AI.findings: 第47(b)条通过以下方式有效隐含了私人诉权：(1) "不可执行"（unenforceability）在普通法中的固有含义；(2) §47(b)(1)与(2)的平行结构；(3)国会与SEC在伴随报告中明确声明法院应在修正条款下隐含私人权利。实证证据表明，撤销救济是针对性、合同层面的补充性救济，而非替代SEC执法。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了法定沉默情形下隐含私人诉权的解释理论，调和了文本主义与实质性救济目标之间的张力，为《投资公司法》的私人执行提供了统一的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为最高法院即将审理的FS Credit Opportunities Corp.案提供分析支持；澄清封闭式基金股东（因固定资本结构和无赎回权而救济途径有限）的法律地位；为投资公司行业合同的可执行性提供可预测性。

title: When Scandals Hit Unevenly: Domain-Embedded Reputational Shocks and Stakeholder Withdrawal
affiliations: Universidad Andrés Bello and

detail.title: When Scandals Hit Unevenly: Domain-Embedded Reputational Shocks and Stakeholder Withdrawal
detail.abstract: How do governance failures reshape stakeholder responses within complex organizations? We argue that reputational shocks do not diffuse uniformly but instead generate heterogeneous and domain-specific reactions depending on how they are interpreted within organizational sub-units. Drawing on a highly salient governance scandal involving a politically exposed actor, we examine how public norm violations disrupt organizational legitimacy and translate into stakeholder behavior. Using a counterfactual comparative design, we show that the shock triggered an abrupt and economically meaningful withdrawal of stakeholder support. Crucially, this response was not uniform: negative reactions concentrated in organizational domains where the shock was both structurally embedded and normatively central to stakeholders' evaluative criteria. Building on organizational legitimacy and reputation research, we develop the concept of domain-embedded normative relevance to explain how reputational shocks are differentially processed within organizations. We show that governance-related norm violations induce rapid belief updating and focal behavioral responses, leading to localized breakdowns of organizational support rather than organization-wide effects. By challenging the view of reputation as a coherent organization-level construct and shifting attention to its internal distribution, this study advances theory on reputational stability and change and highlights the domain-contingent nature of stakeholder evaluation under conditions of uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了治理丑闻如何引发利益相关者的异质性反应，发现声誉冲击并非均匀扩散，而是在组织内部某些特定领域（冲击在这些领域具有结构嵌入性和规范中心性）导致利益相关者支持的局部性崩溃，而非全组织范围的效应。
AI.research_question: 治理失败如何重塑复杂组织内利益相关者的反应？声誉冲击是均匀扩散还是产生了异质性的、领域特定的反应？
AI.motivation: 挑战将声誉视为统一、全组织层面建构的传统观点，揭示声誉冲击在组织内部的不均匀分布及其对利益相关者行为的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织合法性理论、声誉研究、领域嵌入性规范相关性（domain-embedded normative relevance）概念。
AI.method: 反事实比较设计（counterfactual comparative design），基于一起涉及政治暴露行为者的高显著性治理丑闻。
AI.findings: 声誉冲击引发了利益相关者支持的经济意义显著的突然撤离；负面反应集中在冲击具有结构嵌入性和规范中心性的组织领域；治理相关的规范违反会导致快速的信念更新和焦点行为反应，产生局部性而非全组织范围的支持崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了关于声誉稳定性与变化的理论；将注意力从组织层面的声誉转移到声誉的内部分布；提出领域嵌入性规范相关性概念，解释声誉冲击如何在组织内部被差异化处理；揭示了不确定性条件下利益相关者评价的领域权变性。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织理解治理丑闻的风险并非全组织均匀分布，从而在危机管理中更精准地识别和应对高风险的特定领域。

title: Self-Updating Retrieval Mechanisms for Scalable and Personalized RAG Systems in Dynamic Environments
affiliations: Ladoke Akintola University of Technology

detail.title: Self-Updating Retrieval Mechanisms for Scalable and Personalized RAG Systems in Dynamic Environments
detail.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a practical mechanism for improving the factuality, traceability, and domain relevance of large language model (LLM) systems. However, many deployed RAG pipelines remain static: documents are embedded periodically, user context is handled through shallow prompt engineering, and compliance controls are applied after retrieval rather than during inference. These assumptions are increasingly inadequate for healthcare, finance, insurance, and regulated enterprise environments where documents, policies, user permissions, and operational risk profiles change continuously. This paper proposes SURA-RAG , a self-updating retrieval architecture for scalable and personalized RAG systems in dynamic environments. The framework combines event-driven indexing, freshness-aware ranking, edge-cloud LLM orchestration, federated personalization signals, policy-gated retrieval, and explainable evidence logging. A lightweight simulation is presented to compare static RAG, periodic index rebuilding, cloud-only personalization, and the proposed self-updating architecture. Results indicate that SURA-RAG can improve retrieval freshness, reduce stale-answer risk, and strengthen compliance traceability while maintaining acceptable latency. The paper contributes a concise technical framework for privacy-preserving, scalable, and auditable RAG deployment in high-impact sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SURA-RAG，一种面向动态环境的自更新检索增强生成架构，通过事件驱动索引、新鲜度感知排序、边-云LLM编排、联邦个性化信号、策略门控检索和可解释证据记录等机制，提升检索新鲜度、降低陈旧答案风险、增强合规可追溯性，适用于医疗、金融、保险等受监管行业。
AI.research_question: 如何在动态变化的企业环境中（如医疗、金融、保险），构建能够持续自我更新、兼顾个性化与隐私保护、且具备合规可追溯性的RAG系统？
AI.motivation: 现有RAG管道多为静态设计，文档周期性嵌入、用户上下文依赖浅层提示工程、合规控制后置于检索之后，无法适应文档、政策、用户权限和运营风险持续变化的动态企业环境，导致答案陈旧、合规风险高。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件驱动架构、新鲜度感知排序算法、边缘-云协同计算、联邦学习个性化、策略门控访问控制、可解释AI。
AI.method: 提出SURA-RAG框架，包含六大组件：事件驱动索引、新鲜度感知排序、边-云LLM编排、联邦个性化信号、策略门控检索、可解释证据记录；并通过轻量级仿真对比静态RAG、周期性索引重建、纯云个性化与所提架构的性能。
AI.findings: SURA-RAG能够提升检索新鲜度、降低陈旧答案风险、增强合规可追溯性，同时保持可接受的延迟水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个面向动态环境的自更新RAG技术框架，系统整合了事件驱动更新、新鲜度感知排序与策略门控检索等机制，为动态知识环境下的信息检索理论提供了新的设计范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗、金融、保险等高监管行业提供了一个隐私保护、可扩展且可审计的RAG部署方案，帮助企业在文档和政策持续变化的情况下保持回答的准确性与合规性。

reference: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 26/IER/31/01/02; KIET Industrial Economic Review Vol. 31 No. 1, pp. 42-57
title: New Trends in Industrial Policies
affiliations: Organization for Economic Co-Operation and Development (OECD) - Directorate for Science, Technology and Industry (STI), Organization for Economic Co-Operation and Development (OECD) and Organization for Economic Co-Operation and Development (OECD) - Directorate for Science, Technology and Industry (STI)

detail.title: New Trends in Industrial Policies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 26/IER/31/01/02
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics & Trade Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIET Industrial Economic Review Vol. 31 No. 1, pp. 42-57

detail.abstract:
Industrial policy has returned to the forefront of economic policy discussions, driven by the green and digital transitions, supply-chain resilience, and concerns about market concentration and strategic dependencies. This paper argues that the recent surge in industrial-policy discourse and announcements exceeds the expansion of measurable support. Semantic analyses of the Global Trade Alert database indicate a steep increase in announced measures (from 42 in 2010 to 1,483 in 2022).

Using the OECD Quantifying Industrial Strategies (QuIS) database for 17 OECD economies from 2019 to 2023, the paper documents three stylized facts. First, spending through grants and tax expenditures rose by about 10 percent on average (from 1.39 percent to 1.59 percent of GDP), whereas support delivered via financial instruments declined slightly (from 0.97 percent to 0.87 percent of GDP). Second, industrial policy instruments are highly persistent, with limited entry and exit. Third, the observed targets of support have shifted, with expanded schemes related to fixed-capital investment, the green transition, R&D activities, energy costs, and SMEs, alongside reduced sectoral support.

The paper then sets out how to design and govern industrial policy using an OECD policy-cycle lens: a clear conceptual framework and objectives, coordination across policy actors and instruments, robust measurement and benchmarking, implementation capacity, and rigorous ex post evaluation. It concludes by emphasizing the need to strengthen evidence on beneficiaries, large-firm subsidies, and cross-border spillovers to ensure industrial policy supports productivity, resilience, and sustainable growth.

This paper is part of a special series of contributions to Industrial Economic Review commemorating the 50th anniversary of KIET's founding. Lead author Guy Lalanne is the Acting Head of the OECD's Directorate for Science, Technology, and Innovation.

For more on QuIS, follow this link.

AI.tldr: 本文利用OECD QuIS数据库分析了2019-2023年17个OECD经济体的产业政策变化，发现尽管政策 announcements 激增，实际支出增长有限（约GDP的0.2%），且政策工具高度持续、支持对象从部门性转向功能性（绿色转型、研发、中小企业等），最后提出政策设计治理框架。
AI.research_question: 近年来产业政策讨论激增，但实际可衡量的产业政策支持是否真的扩大了？产业政策的设计与治理应如何优化？
AI.motivation: 绿色转型、数字转型、供应链韧性及市场集中度担忧推动产业政策重返经济政策讨论前沿，但政策"说"与"做"之间存在差距，亟需系统量化评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业政策周期框架（OECD政策周期视角）：清晰概念框架与目标、政策行为者与工具的协调、稳健的测量与基准、实施能力、严格的事后评估。
AI.method: 语义分析Global Trade Alert数据库（2010-2022年公告趋势）；利用OECD QuIS数据库对17个OECD经济体2019-2023年数据进行描述性统计分析。
AI.findings: （1）公告数量从2010年42项激增至2022年1,483项，但实际支出仅增长约0.2% GDP；（2）拨款与税收支出从1.39%增至1.59% GDP，金融工具从0.97%降至0.87% GDP；（3）产业政策工具高度持续（进入退出有限）；（4）支持对象从部门性转向固定资产投资、绿色转型、研发、能源成本和中小企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了产业政策"说"与"做"之间的显著差距，提出系统的产业政策治理框架，强调了事后评估与证据基础的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了产业政策设计的原则性指导，指出需加强受益人、大企业补贴及跨境溢出效应的数据证据，以提升生产率、韧性和可持续增长。

title: Educational Degree and Job Satisfaction of Police Non-Commissioned
affiliations: King’s College of the Philippines, King’s College of the Philippines, King’s College of the Philippines, King’s College of the Philippines, King’s College of the Philippines and King’s College of the Philippines

detail.title: Educational Degree and Job Satisfaction of Police Non-Commissioned

declarations.ethicsApproval: 07 May 2025 Mr. Zaldivar Acodesin Chairman Research Ethics Committee Dear Sir, This is to endorse to your good office the research entitled “EDUCATIONAL ALIGNMENT AND JOB SATISFACTION OF NON-COMMISSIONED POLICE OFFICERS IN THE PHILIPPINES”, by Rexcelle Bomaynin Tacio, Abe Colas Omos- ao, Mathias Bassong Chopchopen JR., Joshua Salay Canuto, Earl Palangdao Acong, Drexus Anacioco Eckman, and Pablo Pi-ay Mayos Jr. from the College of Criminal Justice and Education for research ethics review. Sincerely, DR. STEVE A. SOLANO

detail.abstract:
This study was justified by the need to understand how the educational background of Police Non-Commissioned Officers (PNCOs) relates to their assigned duties and overall job satisfaction. Since PNCOs play a vital role in maintaining peace and order, examining whether their college-acquired knowledge and skills are aligned with their responsibilities offers insightful information about workforce efficiency and professional growth. The use of a descriptive correlational research design was appropriate because it allowed the researchers to measure both the degree of educational alignment and its relationship with job satisfaction without manipulating variables. The structured questionnaire ensured that important aspects such as planning, communication, leadership, and analytical skills were assessed alongside indicators of satisfaction like motivation, workplace safety, teamwork, recognition, and work–life balance. By focusing on these areas, the study contributes to a more profound understanding of how education supports police work and highlights opportunities to strengthen officer development and organizational effectiveness. Results showed that PNCOs generally agreed their college education, whether criminology-related or not, contributes to their performance in various aspects of policing. High levels of job
satisfaction were observed, particularly in terms of enjoyment of work, sense of purpose, positive working environment, and contribution to the community, while moderate satisfaction was noted in areas related to financial compensation, recognition, and personal time. The Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.38 indicated a moderate positive relationship between educational alignment and job satisfaction, meaning that officers who consider their academic preparation relevant to their job tend to exhibit higher levels of satisfaction. These findings underscore the value of a relevant educational background and continuous professional development in enhancing performance and wellbeing among PNCOs. The results may guide the Philippine National Police, educational institutions, and policymakers in strengthening training programs, curriculum design, and professional development initiatives for police personnel.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨菲律宾警察士官（PNCOs）的教育背景与职责匹配度及工作满意度之间的关系。研究发现，教育匹配度与工作满意度呈中等正相关（r=0.38），提示相关教育背景和持续专业发展对提升警员绩效与福祉具有重要价值。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾警察士官的教育背景是否与其职责匹配？教育匹配度与工作满意度之间是否存在关系？
AI.motivation: 警察士官在维护治安中扮演关键角色，理解其大学所学知识与实际职责的匹配程度，有助于提升警队效率与专业成长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育-职业匹配理论；工作满意度理论（涵盖动机、安全、团队合作、认可、工作生活平衡等维度）。
AI.method: 描述性相关研究设计；使用结构化问卷调查规划、沟通、领导力、分析技能等维度及工作满意度指标；采用皮尔逊相关系数分析。
AI.findings: PNCOs普遍认为其大学教育（无论是犯罪学相关还是其他专业）对警务工作有贡献；工作满意度整体较高（享受工作、使命感、工作环境、社区贡献），但在薪酬、认可和个人时间方面满意度中等；教育匹配度与工作满意度的皮尔逊相关系数为0.38，呈中等正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了教育背景与职业匹配度对工作满意度的正向影响，丰富了警察职业领域的教育-工作匹配理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾国家警察、教育机构和政策制定者优化培训项目、课程设计和专业发展计划提供实证依据。

title: Asset-Backed Securities in Pakistan: A Legal and Structuring Framework for Debt Capital Markets
affiliations: University of London

detail.title: Asset-Backed Securities in Pakistan: A Legal and Structuring Framework for Debt Capital Markets
detail.abstract: This working paper presents a comprehensive legal and structuring framework for the issuance of asset-backed securities (ABS) in Pakistan, with particular emphasis on debt instruments deployed through private placements targeting foreign entities and institutional investors. Drawing on Pakistan's principal regulatory instruments — the Companies (Asset Backed Securitization) Rules, 1999, the Asset Backed Securitization Regulations, 2022, State Bank of Pakistan BPD Circular No. 31 of 2002, and the rating methodology of the Pakistan Credit Rating Agency — this paper synthesizes the legal, structural, and commercial requirements for viable ABS issuance in an emerging market context. The framework addresses SPV formation and governance, true sale doctrine, bankruptcy remoteness, credit enhancement mechanisms, foreign investor access, and cross-border capital flow facilitation. It aims to serve both as a practitioner guide and a policy-relevant contribution to the development of Pakistan's debt capital markets.

AI.tldr: 本文为巴基斯坦资产支持证券（ABS）的发行构建了全面的法律与结构化框架，重点针对面向外国实体和机构投资者的私募债务工具，梳理了国内主要监管法规、SPV治理、真实销售、破产隔离、信用增级及跨境资本流动等关键要素，兼具实务指南与政策参考价值。
AI.research_question: 如何在巴基斯坦新兴市场环境下，构建一套合法、合规且具有商业可行性的资产支持证券（ABS）发行框架，特别是针对面向外国实体和机构投资者的私募债务工具？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦债务资本市场发展滞后，资产证券化作为重要的融资工具尚未得到充分运用。本文旨在弥合法律框架与实务操作之间的缺口，为巴基斯坦ABS市场的发展提供系统性的结构化指引与政策建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产证券化法律与金融理论，包括：真实销售（True Sale）原则、破产隔离（Bankruptcy Remoteness）机制、信用增级（Credit Enhancement）理论、特殊目的载体（SPV）治理理论，以及新兴市场跨境资本流动与投资者准入相关理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析与框架综合研究。通过对巴基斯坦四项核心监管文件（1999年公司（资产支持证券化）规则、2022年资产支持证券化条例、巴基斯坦国家银行BPD第31号通函、巴基斯坦信用评级机构评级方法）的系统梳理与解读，结合结构化金融实务，构建综合性的ABS发行框架。
AI.findings: 构建了一套涵盖SPV设立与治理、真实销售实现、破产隔离安排、信用增级机制、外国投资者准入及跨境资本流动促进等环节的完整ABS发行法律与结构化框架，明确了各环节在巴基斯坦现行法律下的合规路径与操作要点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将资产证券化的经典金融理论（真实销售、破产隔离、信用增级等）与巴基斯坦新兴市场的法律现实相结合，拓展了资产证券化理论在新兴市场制度环境下的适用性分析，为跨境资产证券化的法律结构化研究提供了国别案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦的从业者（律师、投资银行家、发行人）提供了清晰的操作指南；为政策制定者发展巴基斯坦债务资本市场提供了具体的制度建议；有助于吸引外国机构和机构投资者进入巴基斯坦ABS市场，促进跨境资本流动。

title: Future Strategy for Establishing National Defense Governance Based on the Defense Innovation System: IP-Based Defense Science and Technology Innovation in the AI Era

detail.title: Future Strategy for Establishing National Defense Governance Based on the Defense Innovation System: IP-Based Defense Science and Technology Innovation in the AI Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on documentary and comparative legal analysis and did not involve human participants. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently without external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper presents the first systematic proposal to integrate ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (the world's first AI Management System standard), the Republic of Korea's AI Basic Act (Law No. 21311, effective January 2026), and the Defense Science and Technology Innovation Promotion Act (the 'Innovation Act') into a unified three-tier compliance architecture for defense R&D governance.

Drawing on comparative legal analysis (United States, United Kingdom, France, Germany), Futures Wheel methodology, Delphi expert surveys, and the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), the study identifies three priority domains — legal and institutional reform (AHP weight: 0.3073), IP-based ecosystem development (0.1860), and implementation framework (0.0971) — and proposes twelve actionable policy measures.

Centerpiece proposals include: codification of government third-party licensing rights modeled on 35 U.S.C. §202(c)(4) and §203 (Bayh-Dole); establishment of a Korean-style IP Cadre under 10 U.S.C. §2322; and construction of an integrated defense IP management platform. The study further applies the WIPO IP Panorama 2.0 framework — including Event-Driven IP Audit, Relief from Royalty valuation, and the five essential licensing conditions — to defense export governance for the first time.

The Defense Innovation System (DIS) model proposed herein is designed to operate in virtuous cycle with the National Innovation System (NIS), advancing national competitiveness and economic development through Gisul-Boguk (技術報國) — serving the nation through technology.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地提出将ISO/IEC 42001:2023（全球首个AI管理系统标准）、韩国《AI基本法》和《国防科技创新促进法》整合为统一的国防研发治理三层合规架构，并通过比较法分析、Futures Wheel方法、德尔菲专家调查和AHP方法识别三大优先领域及十二项政策建议，最终提出国防创新系统（DIS）模型以实现技术报国。
AI.research_question: 如何将ISO/IEC 42001:2023、韩国《AI基本法》和《国防科技创新促进法》整合为统一的国防研发治理合规架构？
AI.motivation: 国防研发领域面临多重法律法规的合规挑战，缺乏统一的治理框架，且需要平衡国家安全与技术创新、知识产权管理之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层合规架构、比较法分析、Futures Wheel方法、德尔菲专家调查法、层次分析法（AHP）、WIPO IP Panorama 2.0框架（包括事件驱动型IP审计、特许权使用费减免估值、五项基本许可条件）。
AI.method: 比较法分析（美、英、法、德）、Futures Wheel方法、德尔菲专家调查、层次分析法（AHP）。
AI.findings: 确定了三大优先领域：法律与制度改革（AHP权重0.3073）、基于IP的生态系统发展（0.1860）和实施框架（0.0971），并提出了十二项可操作的政策措施，包括政府第三方许可权法典化、韩国式IP干部制度、整合型国防IP管理平台等。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将WIPO IP Panorama 2.0框架应用于国防出口治理；提出了国防创新系统（DIS）模型及其与国家创新系统（NIS）的良性循环机制；整合了多重国际与国内法律框架的统一合规架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国国防研发治理提供了具体的政策建议（十二项措施）；提出了可操作的IP管理平台建设方案；借鉴美国Bayh-Dole法案模式设计了政府第三方许可权制度；为国防出口中的知识产权管理提供了系统化工具。

title: When Markets Stop Listening: Stochastic Noise Intensity, the Generalized Signal Process, and the Design of Macroprudential Policy

detail.title: When Markets Stop Listening: Stochastic Noise Intensity, the Generalized Signal Process, and the Design of Macroprudential Policy
detail.abstract: This paper extends the dynamic informational asymmetry framework established in Hanson (2025) by treating the noise intensity parameter η not as a fixed exogenous constant but as a time-varying stochastic process with its own governing dynamics. The central limitation of prior models in this literature (from Akerlof (1970) and Leland and Pyle (1977) through Myers and Majluf (1984) and Agrawal and Rao (2015), and including the continuous-time extension in Hanson (2025)) is that the informational environment itself is treated as stationary. In financial crises, it manifestly is not. We introduce a stochastic differential equation for η t that incorporates mean-reverting drift, stochastic volatility, and Poisson jumps, where jump intensity is endogenously linked to the credit risk state variable λ t. We decompose η t into a systematic component common to all institutions and an idiosyncratic component driven by firm-specific opacity, enabling a cross-sectional theory of noise contagion. Within this generalized framework, we formally derive the noise-dominated threshold η * , the level above which the Kalman-Bucy belief-updating mechanism becomes statistically inert and managerial signaling fails regardless of the firm's true solvency. This threshold generalizes the Strategic Exit Condition introduced in Hanson (2026) by adding a second, noise-triggered channel of institutional failure. We then recast the dominant postcrisis regulatory instruments (mandatory disclosure requirements, the Liquidity Coverage Ratio, stress testing, and emergency liquidity facilities) as η-suppression mechanisms within a unified theoretical framework. Our primary policy contribution is a tiered dynamic activation rule that conditions regulatory intervention on the estimated distance between η t and η * , enabling preemptive macroprudential action before noise-dominated panics force the liquidation of solvent institutions. Calibration against market-based proxies demonstrates that Bear Stearns in March 2008 crossed the noise-dominated threshold primarily through the systematic component of η t , while the Lehman Brothers failure in September 2008 reflected elevated idiosyncratic noise compounded by genuine deterioration in the latent value process V t. These findings clarify the appropriate regulatory response for each failure type and carry direct implications for the design of forward-looking macroprudential oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文将噪声强度η从固定外生常数扩展为具有自身动力学方程的时变随机过程，并引入均值回复漂移、随机波动率和泊松跳跃，建立了统一的噪声抑制监管框架，提出了基于η_t与η*距离的分层动态激活规则。
AI.research_question: 当信息环境本身（噪声强度）随时间变化时，信息不对称动态框架如何影响金融市场中的机构行为与监管设计？
AI.motivation: 现有信息不对称模型（从Akerlof 1970到Hanson 2025）都将信息环境视为平稳的，但金融危机中信息环境明显非平稳。需要将噪声强度内生化、动态化以解释危机传播机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 动态信息不对称框架（Hanson 2025扩展）；2. 随机过程理论（均值回复漂移、随机波动率、泊松跳跃）；3. Kalman-Bucy滤波；4. 噪声主导阈值η*；5. 战略退出条件（Hanson 2026）
AI.method: 建立η_t的随机微分方程（含均值回复、随机波动率、Poisson跳跃），将噪声分解为系统性成分和异质性成分，推导噪声主导阈值η*，并基于市场代理变量进行校准（以Bear Stearns和Lehman Brothers为例）。
AI.findings: 1. Bear Stearns（2008年3月）主要因系统性噪声成分跨越η*阈值；2. Lehman Brothers（2008年9月）主要因异质性噪声叠加真实价值V_t恶化；3. 不同类型失败需要不同的监管响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将噪声强度从外生常数扩展为时变随机过程；2. 建立噪声分解为系统性和异质性成分的框架；3. 推导噪声触发的机构失败新渠道；4. 统一解释后危机监管工具为η抑制机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出基于η_t与η*距离估计的分层动态激活规则，实现前瞻性宏观审慎干预，并针对不同类型机构失败提供差异化监管建议。

title: Three Recent Cases on Market Abuse
affiliations: University of Copenhagen - Faculty of Law (FOCOFIMA)

detail.title: Three Recent Cases on Market Abuse

publicationDetails.detailsText: Nordic & European Company Law Working Paper No. 26-01
publicationDetails.journalName: Nordic & European Company Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Three recent cases have arisen from Sweden that all concern the Market Abuse Regulation (596/2014), two were decided by the Court of Justice of the European Union (Finansinspektionen and Brännelius), and one by the Supreme Court of Sweden (Swedbank). The two first concern the concept of inside information, the third concerns market manipulation and free speech. The three cases are analysed and commented upon. Together, they offer a picture of the present state of securities regulation in the European Union.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了瑞典近期三个涉及《市场滥用条例》（MAR）的案例，其中两个由欧盟法院裁决（Finansinspektionen案和Brännelius案），一个由瑞典最高法院裁决（Swedbank案）。前两个案例涉及内幕信息概念，第三个案例涉及市场操纵与言论自由。文章对这些案例进行了分析与评论，共同描绘了欧盟证券监管的现状。
AI.research_question: 瑞典近期三个涉及《市场滥用条例》的案例如何影响和反映欧盟证券监管的现状？
AI.motivation: 通过分析三个具有代表性的最新案例，结合欧盟法院与瑞典最高法院的裁决，揭示内幕信息、市场操纵与言论自由等关键概念在司法实践中的适用与演进，从而呈现欧盟证券监管的制度现状与发展趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟《市场滥用条例》（MAR 596/2014）的法律框架，涉及内幕信息认定、市场操纵行为界定及言论自由保护等理论范畴。
AI.method: 案例分析法。对三个司法案例（Finansinspektionen案、Brännelius案、Swedbank案）进行详细分析与评论。
AI.findings: 三个案例分别聚焦于内幕信息的概念界定以及市场操纵与言论自由的平衡问题，共同反映了欧盟证券监管体系在司法实践中的适用状况与潜在张力。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对《市场滥用条例》关键条款（内幕信息、市场操纵）的司法解释理解，为欧盟证券监管的法律实践提供了实证分析基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 对监管机构、市场参与者和法律从业者理解并适用《市场滥用条例》提供了案例参考，有助于厘清内幕信息边界及市场操纵与言论自由的界限。

title: State-Contingent Pricing for Congestible Public Services: Evidence from Ambulance Policy in Japan
affiliations: , , Kwansei Gakuin University and

detail.title: State-Contingent Pricing for Congestible Public Services: Evidence from Ambulance Policy in Japan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available and aggregated data and does not involve human subjects research requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Open-access yet capacity-constrained public services pose a screening problem: discouraging low-value demand without deterring users in genuine need. We provide causal evidence on an ex-post state-contingent user fee using a 2024 district-wide reform of ambulance transport in Matsusaka District, Japan. Under the reform, transported patients are charged 7,700 yen (about US$50) only if the attending physician determines that hospitalization is unnecessary. Using district-level dispatch records and the Synthetic Control Method, we estimate a 12% reduction in monthly ambulance dispatches (about 165 calls) relative to a synthetic control. To interpret the estimated policy effect, we develop a model of emergency call decisions under uncertainty and congestion that clarifies why retrospective, diagnosis-based pricing can selectively deter individuals with low perceived severity while limiting deterrence for those with high severity signals. Our findings suggest that ex-post state-contingent pricing can be a practical screening device for managing congestion in open-access public services when need can be verified after use.

AI.tldr: 本文利用日本松阪市2024年救护车改革（仅在医生判断无需住院时收取7700日元费用），通过综合控制法发现每月救护车派遣减少12%（约165次），并构建模型解释为何这种事后、基于诊断的定价能有效筛选低价值需求而不影响真正需要救助的患者。
AI.research_question: 事后状态依存的用户费用（ex-post state-contingent user fee）能否作为开放获取但容量受限的公共服务的有效筛选机制，在不抑制真正需求的前提下减少低价值需求？
AI.motivation: 开放获取的公共服务（如救护车）面临拥堵问题，但简单提高价格会阻碍真正有需要的用户。需要一种能区分高、低价值需求的定价机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不确定性下的紧急呼叫决策模型、拥堵效应、事后诊断定价的筛选机制
AI.method: 综合控制法（Synthetic Control Method），结合区级调度记录数据，以及理论模型推导。
AI.findings: 改革使每月救护车派遣减少12%（约165次），且理论模型表明事后诊断定价能选择性阻止低感知严重程度的个体，而对高严重程度信号者的威慑有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了事后状态依存定价作为开放获取公共服务中基于需求的筛选机制的理论框架，阐明了不确定性下紧急呼叫决策的微观机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗服务等开放获取公共服务的拥堵管理提供了可操作的定价政策参考，即在使用后可验证需求时，事后诊断定价可有效筛选低价值需求。

title: Circadian Timing of 24-Hour Movement Behaviors and Respiratory Disease Risk: A Deep Learning-Based Prospective Cohort Study
affiliations: Xiamen University, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University and Xiamen University

detail.title: Circadian Timing of 24-Hour Movement Behaviors and Respiratory Disease Risk: A Deep Learning-Based Prospective Cohort Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used data from the UK Biobank (application number 347405) with ethical approval from the North West Multi-centre Research Ethics Committee. All participants provided written informed consent. NHANES protocols were approved by the National Center for Health Statistics Research Ethics Review Board, with written informed consent obtained. Analyses using publicly available summary statistics complied with relevant data-use policies.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Key R&D Program of China (2021ZD0201300, 2022YFC2704300) and the National Natural Science Foundation of China (32400532, 32570802, 32100532).

detail.abstract:
​Background: Respiratory diseases are pathophysiologically diverse, but whether temporally resolved 24-hour movement behaviours (24-MB) are uniformly associated with risk across this clinical spectrum remains unclear.

Methods: We analysed wrist accelerometry from 92,326 UK Biobank participants, deriving hour-level sleep, sedentary behaviour (SB), light physical activity (LPA) and moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) across workdays and weekends. Twenty-five ICD-10 respiratory diseases were grouped into Acute, Chronic and Other strata. Associations were examined using time-resolved Cox models and restricted cubic splines. A Transformer-based Circadian Respiratory Risk (CRR) model was developed and externally validated in NHANES; Mendelian randomisation and multi-omics mediation assessed causal support and biological plausibility.

Findings: Incident cases showed higher SB and lower LPA/MVPA. The CRR model revealed a prediction gradient, with stronger risk-prediction performance for chronic inflammatory/structural diseases and respiratory failure than for acute infectious outcomes. Temporal associations were diffuse in Chronic diseases, concentrated in Acute diseases and heterogeneous in Other conditions. Early-morning SB was associated with higher risk, whereas later-day LPA/MVPA was generally protective; pneumonia risk was higher with SB at 03:00 (HR 1.91) and lower with MVPA at 18:00 (HR 0.58). Protective MVPA associations began at 43–51 min/day. Females showed stronger SB-associated risk and LPA/MVPA-related protection. Multi-omics analyses implicated shared neutrophil-driven inflammation and disease-specific immune-inflammatory and tissue-remodelling pathways. Optimised 24-MB profiles lowered calibrated predicted risks, and a web platform enables individualised estimation (http://respiratory.zBiolab.cn).

Interpretation: Temporally resolved 24-MB profiles revealed a pathophysiology-stratified predictive architecture of respiratory disease risk, characterised by a prediction gradient across disease strata and distinct temporal vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用UK Biobank 92,326名参与者的腕部加速度计数据，揭示了24小时运动行为（睡眠、久坐、轻度及中高强度体力活动）与25种呼吸系统疾病风险的差异化关联。研究发现，疾病风险预测呈现梯度：慢性炎症/结构性疾病及呼吸衰竭的预测效能高于急性感染性疾病。时间模式上，清晨久坐增加风险，午后中高强度活动具有保护作用（如18:00 MVPA降低42%肺炎风险）。中介分析表明，共享的中性粒细胞驱动的炎症通路及疾病特异性免疫-组织重塑通路介导了上述关联。研究还开发了基于Transformer的昼夜节律呼吸风险（CRR）模型，并搭建了个体化预测网页平台。
AI.research_question: 24小时运动行为的时间解析特征是否与呼吸系统疾病风险存在差异化关联？这种关联是否因呼吸疾病的病理生理异质性（急性、慢性、其他）而有所不同？
AI.motivation: 呼吸系统疾病在病理生理上具有高度异质性，但以往关于运动行为与呼吸健康的研究多采用总量指标（如日均步数、总久坐时间），忽略了行为在一天内的时间分布特征。本研究旨在探索时间解析的24小时运动行为模式是否能够揭示不同病理类型呼吸疾病的风险差异，为精准预防提供时间生物学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间生物学与昼夜节律理论、运动生理学、呼吸病学病理分型理论、多组学中介分析框架。
AI.method: 1) 数据来源：UK Biobank 92,326名参与者腕部加速度计数据，按工作日和周末逐小时提取睡眠、久坐、轻度活动、中高强度活动。2) 疾病分类：25种ICD-10呼吸疾病分为急性、慢性、其他三类。3) 统计建模：时间分辨Cox比例风险模型、限制性立方样条；4) 机器学习：基于Transformer的昼夜节律呼吸风险（CRR）模型；5) 外部验证：NHANES数据；6) 因果推断：孟德尔随机化；7) 机制探索：多组学中介分析。
AI.findings: 1) 病例组久坐时间更高，轻度及中高强度活动更低。2) CRR模型揭示预测梯度：慢性炎症/结构性疾病和呼吸衰竭的预测效能强于急性感染性疾病。3) 时间模式差异：慢性疾病的时间关联分布广泛弥散，急性疾病的时间关联集中，其他疾病异质性大。4) 清晨久坐（如03:00）与更高风险相关，午后中高强度活动（如18:00）具有保护效应（肺炎HR=0.58）。5) 保护性MVPA阈值：43-51分钟/天。6) 性别差异：女性久坐风险关联更强，中高强度活动的保护效应也更显著。7) 多组学分析：共享中性粒细胞驱动的炎症通路及疾病特异性免疫-组织重塑通路。8) 优化24-MB谱可降低校正后预测风险，已搭建个体化预测网页平台。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示时间解析的24小时运动行为与呼吸系统疾病风险之间存在病理生理分层化的预测架构，提出了"预测梯度"概念（慢性>急性），并建立了时间行为模式-疾病病理类型的对应关系，拓展了时间流行病学在呼吸健康领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了精准的时间窗口建议：避免清晨久坐、增加午后中高强度活动（如18:00左右运动）。2) 给出具体的运动量阈值（每日43-51分钟MVPA）。3) 识别性别特异性干预需求：女性需更关注减少久坐。4) 开发了个体化风险预测网页平台（http://respiratory.zBiolab.cn），可直接应用于临床预防和健康管理。

detail.abstract:
In this paper, I offer a brief survey of Japanese industrial policy from the  1950s to the 2020s and on this basis discuss the industrial policies currently  being formulated by the Japanese government. My analysis focuses on industrial  policies aimed at fostering specific industries, which once attracted particular  attention.

Specifically, the paper examines industrial policies that promoted  industrialization through heavy industries like steel, shipbuilding, and chemical  manufacturing when the Japanese economy was rapidly growing, and using this  analysis as a foundation, it considers the new industrial policies implemented  since the 2020s that aim to achieve economic growth while advancing economic security. I address the objectives, instruments, and impacts of industrial  policies throughout the paper.

The paper is organized as follows. Chapter 2 comprises a brief historical survey of Japanese postwar industrial policy. Chapters 3 and 4 analyze the industrial policies implemented during the high-growth period and since the 2020s, respectively. Chapter 5 concludes the paper.

This paper is part of KIET's Global Perspectives series, commemorating the 50th anniversary of its founding. Shujiro Utaro is one of Japan's leading trade economists . He is currently a professor emeritus at Waseda University and the Chairman Emeritus of the Research Institute of Economy, Trade, and Industry.

AI.tldr: 本文梳理了日本从1950年代到2020年代的产业政策演变，重点分析高增长期通过重工业推动工业化的政策，以及2020年代以来旨在兼顾经济增长与经济安全的新型产业政策。
AI.research_question: 日本从1950年代到2020年代的产业政策如何演变？2020年代以来旨在实现经济增长同时推进经济安全的新型产业政策有哪些特点？
AI.motivation: 日本产业政策曾备受关注，但进入2020年代后面临新的经济安全挑战，有必要系统梳理其历史演变与最新动向，为理解当代产业政策提供历史参照。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业政策理论、工业化战略、经济安全理论
AI.method: 历史文献分析与政策梳理，基于日本战后产业政策的纵向比较研究
AI.findings: 日本高增长期通过钢铁、造船、化工等重工业政策成功推动工业化；2020年代以来的新产业政策在追求经济增长的同时，将经济安全纳入核心目标，政策工具和侧重点发生转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 为产业政策理论提供了日本从高速增长期到后工业时代的纵向案例，揭示了产业政策目标从单纯经济增长向兼顾经济安全的演进逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国制定产业政策提供日本经验参考，特别是在如何平衡经济增长与经济安全方面提供实践启示。

title: Price Caps on Petroleum: Implications and Policy Directions
affiliations: and Texas A&M University

detail.title: Price Caps on Petroleum: Implications and Policy Directions

publicationDetails.detailsText: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 26/iKIET/208
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics & Trade Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade i-KIET No. 208

detail.abstract:
This study examines worsening instability in the oil industry’s supply chain due to the ongoing conflict in the 
Middle East and the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, which has placed severe upward pressure on international
oil prices. Prices of petroleum-based products in South Korea have risen rapidly, increasing the burden on 
consumers and fueling inflation concerns. Rising international oil prices are highly likely to feed through to the 
real economy through increased transportation, logistics, and manufacturing costs. 

Skyrocketing prices for Dubai crude (up 49.8 percent) and domestic gasoline prices (up 12.7 percent) since the 
US and Israel began their campaign against Iran have exceeded the initial increases seen when Russia invaded 
Ukraine. In response, the Korean government implemented a price cap system to mitigate market anxiety and 
the spread of inflation expectations. This system, which sets a cap on the prices that oil refiners are allowed to 
sell at every two weeks, has been in effect since March 13, 2026. Following its implementation, national average 
gasoline and diesel prices fell by KRW 70 to KRW 120 from their peaks, showing a stabilizing trend. The government
is also considering a packaged response that combines price caps with other policy instruments, such as 
fuel tax cuts and direct subsidies to consumers. This package of policies could temporarily suppress rapid price 
surges and ease the burden on consumers, but it also risks exacerbating non-price rationing and long-term 
supply shortages. 

Ceilings on prices prevent the price signal from constraining demand, which during a supply shock can worsen 
shortages, lead to long lines at the pump, and eliminate price competition among retailers. Therefore, price 
caps on petroleum need to be utilized with great care as a short-term market stabilization tool, rather than as a 
permanent feature. 

Future policy responses should take a package approach that combines various policy instruments, including 
fuel tax cuts, direct support, the utilization of strategic petroleum reserves, and diversification of import sources. 
Given that fuel dependency and cost structures vary by industry, a differentiated policy response considering 
industry-specific characteristics is necessary, rather than a uniform price regulation. Industries such as logistics, 
freight, fisheries, agriculture, and public transportation are particularly exposed to fuel costs, meaning oil price 
shocks are highly likely to be passed through to production and transportation costs. Thus, the government 
should design targeted support or fuel-cost subsidies. For the oil refining, petrochemical, and energy-intensive 
manufacturing sectors, a policy approach considering supply stability and cost buffering is needed so that medium-
to long-term security of supply and investment incentives are not adversely affected.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了中东冲突和霍尔木兹海峡封锁导致的石油供应链不稳定问题，分析了韩国政府实施的价格上限政策的效果与风险，并提出了综合性的政策应对建议。
AI.research_question: 在中东冲突导致石油价格飙升的背景下，韩国政府实施的石油价格上限政策是否有效？如何设计更优的政策组合以应对石油供应冲击？
AI.motivation: 国际油价因中东冲突和霍尔木兹海峡封锁而大幅上涨，韩国作为石油进口依赖度高的国家，消费者负担加重，通胀压力上升。政府实施了价格上限政策，但该政策可能带来非价格配给和长期供应短缺等风险，因此需要对其效果进行评估并提出更优的政策组合方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格管制理论；供应冲击下的市场均衡分析；非价格配给机制；政策组合理论
AI.method: 案例分析与政策评估：基于韩国石油市场实际数据（迪拜原油价格上涨49.8%、国内汽油价格上涨12.7%），分析价格上限政策实施前后市场价格变化，并结合经济学理论进行政策效果评估。
AI.findings: 1) 自美以对伊朗行动以来，迪拜原油价格上涨49.8%，国内汽油价格上涨12.7%；2) 韩国价格上限政策实施后，汽油和柴油价格从峰值下降70-120韩元，呈现稳定趋势；3) 价格上限虽能短期抑制价格飙升，但会抑制价格信号对需求的约束作用，导致短缺加剧、排队现象和零售竞争消失；4) 不同行业对燃料依赖度不同，应实施差异化的政策应对。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了价格上限政策在供应冲击情境下的双刃剑效应：短期稳定市场但长期可能导致供应短缺，为价格管制理论提供了新的实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国政府及类似石油进口依赖型经济体提供了政策建议：1) 价格上限应作为短期工具谨慎使用；2) 建议采取包含燃油税减免、直接补贴、战略石油储备动用、进口来源多元化的综合政策包；3) 应根据行业特征（物流、渔业、农业、公共交通等高暴露行业）制定差异化支持政策。

detail.abstract: This Article attempts to identify and unify the principles guiding business law--that is, the law regulating commerce, finance, bankruptcy, securities, and business organizations. Each such field of business is currently governed by its own corresponding field of law. This legal fragmentation can be costly and inefficient, however, producing overbroad and inconsistent rules and failing to convey advances in one legal field across other fields. The Article examines the reason for the fragmentation, showing it arose from efforts to solve problems that are specific to the corresponding field of business rather than to correct market failures or other problems that are common to business. To reduce fragmentation, the Article normatively analyzes why business should be regulated and takes steps toward deriving a unified theory of business law. Informed by the connections and commonalities underlying the business-law fields, this theory is intended to supplement and inform, not necessarily replace, existing regulation. The Article also tests the theory by applying it to each field of business.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在识别和统一商业法的基本原则，以减少因法律碎片化导致的成本高、规则不一致等问题，并提出一个补充而非取代现有法规的统一商业法理论。
AI.research_question: 如何识别并统一规范商业、金融、破产、证券和商业组织等领域的商业法基本原则，以减少法律碎片化？
AI.motivation: 当前各商业领域由各自对应的法律领域分别管辖，这种法律碎片化成本高、效率低，产生过宽且不一致的规则，且未能将一个法律领域的进展传递到其他领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碎片化的根源在于解决各商业领域特定问题，而非纠正市场失灵等商业共性问题；基于商业各领域的联系和共性，推导统一的商业法理论。
AI.method: 规范分析：先分析碎片化的成因，再从应然层面分析为何应监管商业，推导统一理论，最后将该理论应用于各商业领域进行检验。
AI.findings: 商业法碎片化源于各领域为解决自身特定问题而发展，而非基于市场失灵等共性问题；提出的统一理论能够补充和指导现有监管。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次尝试识别并统一商业法的基本原则，提出补充性而非替代性的统一理论，揭示了商业法碎片化的深层原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 为减少商业法碎片化、降低合规成本、提高规则一致性提供理论指导，促进跨法律领域的知识传递。

title: Access, Not Ownership: An Orthogonality Theorem for AI Governance Regimes
affiliations: GenAI Architect; Independent Researcher

detail.title: Access, Not Ownership: An Orthogonality Theorem for AI Governance Regimes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical contribution based exclusively on publicly available case-grid evidence (cross-jurisdictional regulatory regime descriptions, statutory templates, and published industrial-organization data); it does not involve human participants, identifiable personal data, animal subjects, or any data requiring institutional ethics review.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract:
The contemporary debate over AI governance is organized along a single axis: public ownership of foundation-model infrastructure (the public-AI position; Vipra and Korinek 2023; Mazzucato 2015) versus private oligopoly with the techno-feudalism critique as a limit case (Varoufakis 2023; Durand 2024). Korinek and Vipra (2025) prove that under bundled access and quality-recursion returns to scale (Λ > 1), foundation-model markets tip to monopoly. This paper supplies the constructive counterpart: under structural decoupling on a three-component access vector μ = (ω, π, ν) (weight openness, compute portability, verification unbundling), tipping fails to fire and ownership type θ becomes welfare-second-order.

The argument runs through five theorems. (T1) An Access-Structure Separation Theorem (characterization form): θ ⊥_W μ iff the regulatory regime is ownership-invariant, with four sufficient mechanisms (M_α)–(M_δ); this generalizes the privatization-neutrality literature (Sappington and Stiglitz 1987; White 1996; Matsumura 1998; Tomaru 2025) on three axes simultaneously — vector-μ access structure replaces scalar θ, the four mechanism families are unified under a single decomposition, and the result is chained to the natural-monopoly Λ > 1 regime via T3. (T2) A Monopolization Inequality Bound on mean log deviation, GE_0* − GE_0^(0) ≤ κ_1 s_K(η)(1−μ) + κ_2 R̃(ν), with capital-rent and certification-rent channels bounded separately, and a Gini corollary under Lerman and Yitzhaki (1985) comonotonicity. (T3) An Anti-Tipping Theorem with closed-form effective scale exponent Λ^eff(ω, π, ν) = δ(1−ω) + (β+γ) r(ω, π, ν) on Korinek and Vipra (2025)'s technology specification, yielding a single-lever sufficient condition ω > (Λ − 1)/[δ + (β+γ) w_p] that identifies weight openness as the sharpest policy variable in the moderate-Λ, moderate-w_p regime; at large Λ or low w_p a multi-lever bundle is required. (T4) A Verification-Binding Theorem on the credence-good portion of the foundation-model output space, derived from Darby and Karni (1973), Lizzeri (1999), and Klein and Leffler (1981): there exists c > 0 independent of (ω, π) such that W*(ω, π, ν) − W*(ω, π, 0) ≥ c·ν (welfare gain from ν-unbundling is linear in ν at first order). The credence-good gap independence is proved as a derived lemma. (T5) A Long-run Orthogonality Theorem via Stigler–Peltzman–Becker capture-game (Peltzman 1976; Becker 1983; Grossman and Helpman 1994; Laffont and Tirole 1991) showing the static result survives political-economy feedback under regulatory commitment plus rent-zero + IC-financing implementation; the result extends to multi-agency regulation under the Laffont and Tirole (1991) dual-regulator extension.

We validate against a 2×2 case grid (Soviet Gosplan, Saudi Aramco, Norway, Linux, OpenAI–Anthropic–Google trio, Bell System, China Mobile pre- and post-2008). The empirical record is consistent with the credence-good access channel but does not isolate it from six institutional-economics rivals (institutional-origins, resource-curse, first-mover, common-law, Cold-War, trust-radius); discriminating tests require infrastructure not yet built. Three policy mechanisms (compute portability modelled on 47 U.S.C. §251(b)(2) telecom number portability; open-weights minimum disclosure modelled on Hatch–Waxman 21 U.S.C. §355(j); verification unbundling modelled on NRSRO licensing 15 U.S.C. §78o-7) are structurally invariant to ownership type. The verification-unbundling proposal draws the cautionary lesson from the 2008 GFC NRSRO failure (White 2010; Mathis et al. 2009): we treat NRSRO as counter-example, not exemplar, and derive five capture-resistance constraints (C1)–(C5) from its specific failure modes. The paper engages the antimonopoly counter-position of Narechania and Sitaraman (2024) directly: the Networks–Platforms–Utilities toolkit is an implementing instrument for components of μ, not a free-standing alternative to access regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在基础模型市场中，通过结构解耦（权重开放性、算力可移植性、验证解绑）的三维接入向量μ，市场垄断趋势可以被打破，且所有权类型（公有vs私有）对福利的影响是二阶的。通过五条定理和政治经济学扩展，论证了接入结构设计比所有权归属更重要。
AI.research_question: 在基础模型市场中，如何通过接入结构的设计（而非所有权归属）来防止市场垄断，并实现福利优化？
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理辩论过于聚焦于公有vs私有的所有权轴，但Korinek & Vipra (2025)证明在捆绑接入和规模回报条件下市场必然向垄断倾斜。本文旨在提供建设性对策：通过接入结构解耦来阻止市场倾覆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合了萨平顿-斯蒂格利茨私有化中性文献、Korinek & Vipra的自然垄断技术设定、Darby-Karni信任品理论、Lizzeri认证理论、Stigler-Peltzman-Becker政治经济学捕获理论等多条理论线索。
AI.method: 五条形式化定理推导（T1-T5），包括接入结构分离定理、垄断化不平等界、反倾覆定理、验证绑定定理和长期正交定理；辅以2×2案例网格比较（苏联国家计划委员会、沙特阿美、挪威、Linux、OpenAI-Anthropic-Google等10个案例）。
AI.findings: (1) 当权重开放性ω > (Λ − 1)/[δ + (β+γ) w_p]时，单一杠杆（权重开放）即可阻止市场倾覆；(2) 验证解绑带来的福利增益在一阶上随ν线性增长；(3) 实证案例与信任品接入渠道一致，但无法排除六种制度经济学替代解释；(4) 三种政策机制（算力可移植性、开放权重最低披露、验证解绑）在所有权类型上结构不变。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将私有化中性文献从标量θ推广到向量μ三维接入结构；(2) 统一了四种机制族(M_α)-(M_δ)于单一分解下；(3) 通过T3将结果链式连接至自然垄断Λ>1体制；(4) 推导出信任品差距独立引理。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三种具体政策机制：算力可移植性（借鉴电信携号转网）、开放权重最低披露（借鉴Hatch-Waxman仿制药法案）、验证解绑（借鉴NRSRO评级机构许可制度，同时吸取2008年金融危机教训提出五条抗捕获约束）。明确回应了Narechania & Sitaraman (2024)的反垄断网络-平台-公用事业工具箱，指出该工具箱是μ的施行工具而非独立替代方案。

reference: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming
title: Planning for the Unknown: The Impact of Longevity Expectations on Retirement Readiness
affiliations: TIAA Institute, Stanford University - Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research and Stanford Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Planning for the Unknown: The Impact of Longevity Expectations on Retirement Readiness

publicationDetails.detailsText: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming

detail.abstract: New TIAA Institute-GFLEC research reveals that workers' expectations about how long they'll live in retirement directly influence their saving and planning behavior. Yet many Americans lack longevity literacy—the understanding of how long people typically live after reaching retirement age—putting their retirement security at risk. This fourth report in the Personal Finance (P-Fin) Index longevity series demonstrates that workers who anticipate longer retirements are significantly more diligent about retirement planning and saving than those expecting shorter retirements. Only 48% of workers expecting fewer than 10 years in retirement save regularly, compared to 71% of those anticipating 30 or more years. These expectations are strongly shaped by workers' perceptions of typical life expectancy at age 65—yet only 33% of U.S. adults can correctly identify this, while 32% underestimate it and 22% admit they don't know. This poor longevity literacy creates a critical retirement security challenge: workers who underestimate typical lifespans plan with horizons that are effectively "too short," save less diligently, and risk having inadequate financial resources during what may prove to be a lengthy retirement.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，美国工人对退休后寿命长度的预期直接影响其储蓄和规划行为，但大部分人对预期寿命缺乏正确认知，导致储蓄不足和退休保障风险。
AI.research_question: 工人的退休寿命预期如何影响其退休储蓄与规划行为？以及美国民众的"寿命素养"（ longevity literacy）现状如何？
AI.motivation: 许多美国人缺乏对退休后典型寿命时长的准确理解，这可能危及他们的退休安全，需要通过研究揭示这一问题的严重性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于个人财务指数（P-Fin Index）长寿系列的调查框架，探讨预期寿命认知与储蓄行为之间的关系。
AI.method: 基于TIAA研究所与GFLEC合作开展的P-Fin Index长寿系列第四份报告数据，对工人预期退休时长与储蓄规划行为进行描述性统计和对比分析。
AI.findings: （1）预期退休时间越长的工人，退休规划和储蓄行为越积极：预期少于10年的仅48%定期储蓄，但预期30年以上的达71%；（2）仅33%的美国成年人能正确说出65岁时的典型预期寿命，32%低估，22%表示不知道；（3）低估预期寿命的工人实际上以"过短"的视界进行规划，储蓄更不积极，面临退休资源不足的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"寿命素养"（ longevity literacy）作为影响退休财务行为的关键认知因素，丰富了行为经济学与个人财务规划领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融机构提供了教育干预的方向：应提高公众对退休后预期寿命的正确认知，以促进更充分的退休储蓄和规划行为。

reference: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming
title: Contribution Location Decisions and Inertia in Retirement Plans: Evidence from the Nonprofit Sector
affiliations: TIAA Institute and TIAA Institute

detail.title: Contribution Location Decisions and Inertia in Retirement Plans: Evidence from the Nonprofit Sector

publicationDetails.detailsText: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming

detail.abstract: Employers offering defined contribution (DC) plans have the option to provide traditional tax-deferred accounts, Roth accounts, or both. Traditional accounts provide deferral of contributions and asset earnings, with distributions fully taxable. By comparison, Roth contributions are not deducted from current taxable income, and withdrawals (including asset earnings) are tax-free. In this study, we analyze the characteristics of workers who are Roth contributors within a TIAA record kept plan. Among actively contributing participants, 42% had a Roth account option in their retirement plan. We find 12% of participants use a Roth option. Utilization of a Roth option depends on age, default status, plan contribution requirements, and whether a Roth option was available when joining the plan. We find evidence of contribution inertia, with participants who did not have a Roth option when joining the plan being less likely to have Roth contributions. Participants who are younger, not plan investment defaulters, and in a DC plan with mandatory employee contributions are significantly more likely to locate contributions to a Roth account. Half of Roth contributors use Roth accounts exclusively. Roth-contributing participants save more on a tax-equivalent basis except when they have mandatory contributions. Our results provide insight into how plan design impacts household tax location decisions and provides insights into how retirement policy changes may affect household retirement security.

AI.tldr: 本文基于TIAA记录数据，分析了DC养老金计划中员工对Roth账户的选择行为。研究发现42%的参与者拥有Roth选项，但实际使用率仅12%。使用率受年龄、默认状态、计划缴费要求以及加入时是否已有Roth选项等因素影响。存在缴费惯性，年轻、非默认投资者、强制缴费计划中的参与者更倾向使用Roth。约半数Roth使用者仅使用Roth账户，且在税收等价基础上储蓄更多。研究揭示了计划设计对家庭税收位置决策的影响。
AI.research_question: 在DC养老金计划中，哪些特征的员工会选择使用Roth账户？计划设计如何影响家庭的税收位置决策？
AI.motivation: 雇主在提供DC计划时可选择传统税收递延账户、Roth账户或两者兼具。传统账户允许缴费和收益递延纳税，提取时全额征税；Roth账户缴费不可税前扣除，但提取（含收益）免税。理解员工对Roth账户的选择行为有助于评估退休政策变化对家庭退休保障的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收位置决策理论、缴费惯性理论、计划设计对行为的影响
AI.method: 基于TIAA记录数据，对DC计划中Roth账户使用情况进行实证分析，考察年龄、默认状态、计划缴费要求、加入时Roth选项可用性等因素的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 42%参与者有Roth选项，实际使用率仅12%。2. 使用率受年龄、默认状态、计划缴费要求和加入时Roth选项可用性影响。3. 存在缴费惯性：加入时无Roth选项的参与者更少使用Roth。4. 年轻、非默认投资者、强制缴费计划中的参与者更倾向使用Roth。5. 半数Roth使用者仅使用Roth账户。6. 除强制缴费情况外，Roth使用者在税收等价基础上储蓄更多。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了计划设计（如默认状态、加入时选项可用性）如何影响家庭的税收位置决策，丰富了退休储蓄行为与税收激励领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为雇主设计DC计划（如是否提供Roth选项、如何设置默认状态）提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者理解退休政策变化对家庭退休保障的潜在影响。

reference: Liberty Street Economics
title: AI’s Macroeconomic Challenges and Promises

detail.title: AI’s Macroeconomic Challenges and Promises

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In the third quarter of 2025, America’s largest tech firms for the first time spent more on capital investment than they earned from operations. The implication is that AI, a technology with the potential to make the economy more productive, is, for now, absorbing resources faster than it is generating returns. This post discusses how the tension between AI’s long-run promise and its short-run costs affects the outlooks for inflation, real activity, and financial stability.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/05/ais-macroeconomic-challenges-and-promises/

AI.tldr: 2025年第三季度，美国大型科技公司的资本投资首次超过运营收入，表明AI技术目前消耗资源的速度快于其产生回报的速度。本文讨论了AI长期潜力与短期成本之间的张力对通胀、实际活动和金融稳定的影响。
AI.research_question: AI技术的长期承诺与短期成本之间的张力如何影响宏观经济（通胀、实际活动、金融稳定）？
AI.motivation: 2025年Q3美国大型科技公司资本投资首次超过运营收入这一关键事实表明，AI技术在产生回报之前正在大量吸收资源，需要分析这一现象对宏观经济的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI技术的短期成本与长期收益的权衡理论；生产率悖论（Solow悖论）的现代延伸；技术投资与经济周期理论。
AI.method: 基于纽约联储的宏观经济学分析框架，结合美国大型科技公司的财务数据和宏观经济指标进行论述性分析。
AI.findings: 大型科技公司的AI资本投资短期内超过运营收入，AI技术目前是资源吸收者而非回报创造者；这种短期成本与长期承诺的张力对通胀、实际经济增长和金融稳定构成复杂影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI投资与传统生产率悖论理论相结合，提出了AI技术在宏观经济层面的短期"资源吸收"与长期"生产力释放"的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了关于AI投资热潮对通胀压力、经济增长动能和金融系统稳定性影响的警示性分析。

title: Modern U.S. Industrial Policy as Economic Security
affiliations: Council on Foreign Relations and

detail.title: Modern U.S. Industrial Policy as Economic Security
detail.abstract:
Industrial policy has returned to the United States in full force. Three administrations have implemented new policy frameworks to shape the future of the U.S. economy through government intervention. However, while industrial policy under two different presidents—Donald Trump and Joe Biden—has largely been driven by similar overarching goals, their approaches to achieving the objectives of revitalizing the U.S. industrial base, competing against geopolitical rivals, and leveraging allies to support U.S. hegemony have varied. Despite that variation, U.S. industrial policy evolved considerably from the first to the second Trump administration. While the underlying motivations may have remained broadly consistent, the broadening of the industrial policy toolkit in each successive administration reflects a process of learning and political adaptation.

 The three phases of modern U.S. industrial policy can best be described as experimental, everything bagel, and imperial. The first Trump administration employed a range of tools, but had no overarching strategy; the Biden administration employed a traditional toolkit, relying predominantly on legislation, but had wide-ranging objectives that sometimes worked at cross-purposes; and the second Trump administration has so far overseen a more robust executive promoting aggressive government interventions in private markets. Neither administration has directly acknowledged the tradeoffs involved in their specific interventions. While many of the policies of the second Trump administration remain to be seen, the patterns that have emerged in the last year present a significant evolution of U.S. industrial policy that leans more heavily on the executive branch. This carries significant consequences for the future of American industrial strategy, as well as U.S. foreign economic relations.

AI.tldr: 本文梳理了美国现代产业政策的三个阶段（特朗普第一任期、拜登任期、特朗普第二任期），指出其从"实验性"到"百吉饼式"再到"帝国式"的演变过程，强调行政权力扩张和产业政策工具不断拓宽的趋势。
AI.research_question: 美国现代产业政策经历了怎样的演变？不同行政当局的政策工具与策略有何异同？
AI.motivation: 产业政策已全面回归美国，但不同总统（特朗普与拜登）及其不同任期在实现相似目标（振兴工业基础、对抗地缘竞争对手、利用盟友维持美国霸权）时采取了不同方法，值得系统梳理与分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策学习与政治适应性理论；产业政策工具分类与行政权力演变的视角。
AI.method: 比较案例分析：对三届行政当局（特朗普第一任期、拜登任期、特朗普第二任期）的产业政策工具、策略和总体框架进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 1）美国产业政策经历了"实验性→百吉饼式→帝国式"三阶段演变；2）特朗普第一任期工具多样但缺乏整体战略；3）拜登任期依赖传统立法手段但目标宽泛且相互冲突；4）特朗普第二任期依靠更强有力的行政权力推进激进的政府市场干预；5）各届政府均未直接承认其干预的权衡取舍；6）产业政策工具在每届政府中不断拓宽，反映了学习和政治适应过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了美国现代产业政策三阶段框架（实验性、百吉饼式、帝国式），揭示了行政权力扩张与政策工具演变之间的关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国产业政策的演变轨迹及其对美国未来工业战略和对外经济关系的潜在影响提供了分析框架。

title: Poisoning the Compliance Mind: Adversarial Memory Injection Attacks on RAG-Based AML Agents and a Defense Framework for High-Stakes Financial Environments

detail.title: Poisoning the Compliance Mind: Adversarial Memory Injection Attacks on RAG-Based AML Agents and a Defense Framework for High-Stakes Financial Environments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests. This research was conducted independently without commercial funding.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research involved no human participants, patient data, or personally identifiable information. All experiments were conducted on synthetic datasets (PaySim simulator) and publicly available benchmark data (Elliptic dataset). No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. Conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines are increasingly deployed as the decision-making core of autonomous anti-money laundering (AML) agents in production financial institutions. Unlike stateless classifiers, these agents maintain a persistent vector memory that conditions every downstream compliance decision. We demonstrate that this architectural feature introduces a critical attack surface: adversarial memory injection, whereby an attacker influencing documents ingested into the agent's memory can systematically degrade risk-scoring accuracy and suppress suspicious activity report (SAR) generation. We formalise this threat as the Compliance Memory Poisoning Problem (CMPP) and characterise three injection vectors on a synthetic AML corpus derived from the PaySim simulator. Our most striking finding is that query-time prompt injection (QTPI) collapses agent F1 from a baseline of 0.919 to 0.014 at an injection budget of just 50 documents-a 98.4% degradation rendering the agent operationally equivalent to random guessing. Document-level corpus poisoning and retrieval-rank manipulation show high resistance (F1 ≥ 0.924) under heuristic classification, a finding we interpret as evidence of strong keyword-based priors and a critical motivator for LLM-backend evaluation. In response, we design the Memory Hygiene Layer (MHL)-a modular, training-free defense comprising cryptographic provenance tracking (CPT), cross-encoder factual consistency scoring (FCS), and statistical retrieval anomaly detection (SRAD). CPT achieves 100% adversarial document detection with 0% false quarantine rate; FCS introduces effective semantic filtering at 22.6 ms p99 latency, with threshold calibration required to control false quarantine (30.4-59.8% depending on threshold). These findings directly inform FINRA 2026 agentic AI governance requirements and FCA traceability standards.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了检索增强生成（RAG）驱动的反洗钱智能体面临一种新型安全威胁——对抗性记忆注入攻击，并设计了内存卫生层（MHL）防御框架。攻击者仅需注入50份文档，即可使智能体F1分数从0.919骤降至0.014（下降98.4%），使其等同于随机猜测。MHL通过加密溯源（100%检测率、0%误隔离）、交叉编码器事实一致性评分和统计检索异常检测有效防御。
AI.research_question: RAG驱动的反洗钱智能体在面对对抗性记忆注入攻击时是否脆弱？如何设计有效的防御机制？
AI.motivation: RAG管线正被部署为金融机构反洗钱智能体的决策核心，其持久向量记忆架构引入了一个关键攻击面——对抗性记忆注入，可能系统性破坏风险评估准确性和可疑交易报告生成，但此前缺乏系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合规记忆投毒问题（CMPP）的形式化定义；三种注入向量分类（查询时提示注入、文档级语料投毒、检索排名操纵）；基于PaySim仿真器的合成反洗钱语料库。
AI.method: 在PaySim仿真器生成的合成AML语料库上，针对三种注入向量进行攻击实验（查询时提示注入、文档级语料投毒、检索排名操纵），并设计内存卫生层（MHL）防御框架，包含加密溯源追踪、交叉编码器事实一致性评分和统计检索异常检测。
AI.findings: (1) 查询时提示注入以50份文档的预算使F1从0.919降至0.014（下降98.4%）；(2) 文档级语料投毒和检索排名操纵在启发式分类下具有高抵抗性（F1≥0.924）；(3) 加密溯源追踪实现100%对抗性文档检测和0%误隔离率；(4) 交叉编码器一致性评分实现22.6ms p99延迟的有效语义过滤，但需校准阈值以控制误隔离率（30.4%-59.8%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次形式化定义合规记忆投毒问题（CMPP），系统刻画RAG驱动AML智能体的三种攻击向量，揭示持久向量记忆架构的关键安全脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 设计模块化、免训练的内存卫生层（MHL）防御框架，可直接对接FINRA 2026代理AI治理要求和FCA可追溯性标准，为金融机构部署RAG系统提供实操性安全指南。

title: The Standards of Average and Vulnerable Consumers in the Case Law of Serbia and Türkiye
affiliations: University of Kragujevac Law Faculty and Istanbul Bilgi University

detail.title: The Standards of Average and Vulnerable Consumers in the Case Law of Serbia and Türkiye

declarations.funderStatement: The preliminary stage of the project, of which this research is a part, was generously funded by a joint Poland–Belgium (Wallonia) research grant, PPN/BWA/2019/1/00010.

detail.abstract: As a part of a special issue that includes several contributions presenting national findings in regional clusters, this paper examines the notions of the average and vulnerable consumer in Turkish and Serbian case law. The case law analysis shows, among other things, that courts and administrative authorities recognize that the average consumer does not read contracts thoroughly, does not master foreign languages, and has a rather limited attention span.  Serbian competent authority does not impose higher expectations on the average consumer, whereas Turkish law does present several instances of such slightly higher standards, where courts place the duty to conduct thorough research on the consumers of certain products. A similarly higher threshold is adopted in trademark cases as the average consumer of a more expensive or essential product or service is expected to be more cautious and sophisticated. Turkish administrative authorities also treat several online interface designs as unfair commercial practices, particularly where consumers are nudged into unintended choices through pre-ticked options, automatic subscription renewals following “free trials,” or hidden additional charges. On the other hand, certain contracts are considered to exclude the possibility of a consumer transaction regardless of how the consumer involved may hold the features of an average consumer. So far, Serbian case law has not shown an inclination to impose these higher standards. The inadequate application and understanding of basic consumer law concepts are most evident in the context of the vulnerable consumer. Case law in both countries appears to avoid assessing this legal standard.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析土耳其和塞尔维亚的案例法，探讨了"普通消费者"和"弱势消费者"概念在法律实践中的适用情况，发现两国法院在消费者保护标准上存在差异，且均未充分适用弱势消费者概念。
AI.research_question: 土耳其和塞尔维亚的司法与行政实践中，如何界定和适用"普通消费者"与"弱势消费者"概念？
AI.motivation: 消费者法基本概念的适用在实践中存在不一致性，特别是在不同国家和不同案件类型（商标、合同、在线设计等）中，"普通消费者"的标准存在差异，而"弱势消费者"概念则被普遍忽视，需要系统梳理和比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者保护法中的"普通消费者"标准理论（注意力有限、不精通外语、不细致阅读合同等）和"弱势消费者"保护理论。
AI.method: 案例法分析，比较土耳其和塞尔维亚的法院判决及行政当局裁决。
AI.findings: （1）两国均认可普通消费者不细读合同、不精通外语、注意力有限；（2）塞尔维亚未对普通消费者设定更高期望，土耳其则在某些产品上要求消费者进行深入研究；（3）土耳其对高价/必需品商标案件的消费者要求更高；（4）土耳其将预勾选选项、免费试用后自动续费、隐藏收费等在线设计视为不公平商业行为；（5）某些合同被认定为不可能构成消费者交易；（6）两国案例法均回避评估"弱势消费者"标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"普通消费者"概念在司法实践中的情境化差异，以及"弱势消费者"概念在实际适用中的缺失，丰富了消费者保护法的比较法研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其和塞尔维亚（及类似法域）的立法者、法院和行政当局提供了消费者保护标准适用不一致的实证证据，提示需加强对弱势消费者概念的理解与适用，以及在线商业行为监管的完善方向。
